#load in of packages
```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pacman")

pacman::p_load("biomaRt", "ggplot2", "tibble", "dplyr", "tidyr", "stringr", "readr", "openxlsx", "ComplexUpset", "devtools", "edgeR", "limma", "lme4", "emmeans", "ggbeeswarm", "ggbreak", "ggsignif", "ComplexHeatmap", "grid", "ggrepel", "ggh4x", "ggnewscale", "scales", "clusterProfiler", "forcats", "ggtext", "org.Hs.eg.db", "circlize", "viper", "dorothea", "decoupleR", "reticulate", "patchwork")
```

#Count and sample data read-in
```{r}
#Set ensembl mart
mart <- useEnsembl(biomart = "genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

#read in of RNA-seq count matrix
hypoxia_data <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("data/hypoxia_data.xlsx")

hypoxia_data <- hypoxia_data %>%
  dplyr::select(-contains("FPKM"))

#To remove the Homo_sapiens improperly annotated genes
#hypoxia_data <- hypoxia_data[!grepl("Homo_sapiens", hypoxia_data$`#ID`), ]

rownames(hypoxia_data) <- hypoxia_data$`#ID`

hypoxia_data <- hypoxia_data[, c(3:123)]

sum(rowSums(hypoxia_data >= 1) > 0)
sum(rowSums(hypoxia_data >= 1) >= ncol(hypoxia_data) / 2)

#read in of sample information
sampledatahypoxia <- read.xlsx("data/hypoxia_sampledata.xlsx")

order_sessions <- read.xlsx("Hypoxia_session_order.xlsx")
order_sessions <- order_sessions %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("session_"),
    names_to = "session",
    values_to = "condition"
  )

order_sessions <- order_sessions %>%
  mutate(
    session_number = case_when(
      session == "session_1" ~ 1,
      session == "session_2" ~ 2,
      session == "session_3" ~ 3
    )
  )

sampledatahypoxia <- sampledatahypoxia %>%
  left_join(
    order_sessions %>%
      dplyr::select(participant, condition, session, session_number),
    by = c("sampleid" = "participant", "condition" = "condition")
  )


```

#Compare NA8B1 and NA8B2 (technical replicates - ignore)
```{r}
total_sumB1 <- sum(hypoxia_data$NA8B1_count, na.rm = TRUE)
total_sumB2 <- sum(hypoxia_data$NA8B2_count, na.rm = TRUE)
adjustfactor <- total_sumB1 / total_sumB2

absolute_differences <- ((abs(hypoxia_data$NA8B2_count - hypoxia_data$NA8B1_count) / 
                        hypoxia_data$NA8B2_count) / adjustfactor) *100

absolute_differences[hypoxia_data$NA8B1_count == 0 & hypoxia_data$NA8B2_count == 0] <- 0

absolute_differences[is.na(absolute_differences) | is.infinite(absolute_differences)] <- NA

absolute_differencesframe <- data.frame(values = absolute_differences)

ggplot(absolute_differencesframe, aes(x = values)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "lightblue", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Histogram of absolute count differences (NA8B2 vs NA8B1)", x = "Difference", y = "Frequency") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme_minimal()

average_absolute_differences <- mean(absolute_differences, na.rm = TRUE)

hypoxia_data <- hypoxia_data %>% dplyr::select(-NA8B1_count)
names(hypoxia_data)[names(hypoxia_data) == "NA8B2_count"] <- "NA8B_count"
```

#DE analysis using voom/limma
```{r}
#ensure sample data and meta data are lined up
orderhypoxia <- sampledatahypoxia$rnaseq
hypoxia_data <- hypoxia_data[, orderhypoxia]
sampledatahypoxia <- na.omit(sampledatahypoxia)

grouphypoxia <- t(sampledatahypoxia[c(3)])
yhypoxia <- DGEList(counts = hypoxia_data , group = grouphypoxia)

condition <- sampledatahypoxia$condition
sampleidhypoxia <- sampledatahypoxia$sampleid
session <- sampledatahypoxia$session

yhypoxia$samples$condition <- as.factor(condition)
yhypoxia$samples$sampleidhypoxia <- as.factor(sampleidhypoxia)
yhypoxia$samples$session <- as.factor(session)

cpmhypoxia <- edgeR::cpm(yhypoxia)
lcpmhypoxia <- edgeR::cpm(yhypoxia, log=TRUE)

L <- mean(yhypoxia$samples$lib.size) * 1e-6
M <- median(yhypoxia$samples$lib.size) * 1e-6
max(yhypoxia$samples$lib.size)
c(L, M)
summary(lcpmhypoxia)

yhypoxia_unfilt <- yhypoxia
yhypoxia_unfilt <- calcNormFactors(yhypoxia_unfilt, method = "TMM")
write.xlsx(yhypoxia_unfilt$counts, "hypoxiacountsdata.xlsx", rowNames = TRUE)

table(rowSums(yhypoxia$counts==0)==120)
keep.exprs <- filterByExpr(yhypoxia, group=grouphypoxia)

yhypoxia <- yhypoxia[keep.exprs,,keep.lib.sizes=FALSE]
dim(yhypoxia)

totalcountshypoxia <- mean(yhypoxia$samples$lib.size) *1e-6

yhypoxia <- calcNormFactors(yhypoxia, method = "TMM")
yhypoxia$samples$norm.factors

grouphypoxia <- grouphypoxia[1:nrow(yhypoxia$samples)]
condition <- condition[1:nrow(yhypoxia$samples)]

designhypoxia <- model.matrix(~0 + grouphypoxia:condition, yhypoxia$samples)
colnames(designhypoxia) <- gsub("grouphypoxia", "", colnames(designhypoxia))
colnames(designhypoxia) <- gsub(":condition", "", colnames(designhypoxia))

contr.matrixhypoxia <- makeContrasts(
 "POSTvsPRE(NA)" = POSTNS-PRENS,
 "H3vsPRE(NA)" = H3NS-PRENS,
 "H24vsPRE(NA)" = H24NS-PRENS,
 "POSTvsPRE(NR)" = POSTNR-PRENR,
 "H3vsPRE(NR)" = H3NR-PRENR,
 "H24vsPRE(NR)" = H24NR-PRENR,
 "POSTvsPRE(HY)" = POSTHY-PREHY,
 "H3vsPRE(HY)" = H3HY-PREHY,
 "H24vsPRE(HY)" = H24HY-PREHY,
 "Dif at 24(HYvsNR)" = (H24HY-PREHY) - (H24NR-PRENR),
 "Dif at 3(HYvsNR)" = (H3HY-PREHY) - (H3NR-PRENR),
 "Dif at 3(NRvsNA)" = (H3NR-PRENR) - (H3NS-PRENS),
 "Dif at 24(NRvsNA)" = (H24NR-PRENR) - (H24NS-PRENS),
 "Baseline(HYvsNA)" = PREHY - PRENS,
 "Baseline(NRvsNA)" = PRENR - PRENS,
 "Baseline(HYvsNR)" = PREHY - PRENR,
  levels = colnames(designhypoxia))
contr.matrixhypoxia

fithypoxia <- voomLmFit(yhypoxia, design = designhypoxia, block = sampleidhypoxia, keep.EList = TRUE, plot = TRUE, save.plot = FALSE)

fithypoxia <- contrasts.fit(fithypoxia, contrasts=contr.matrixhypoxia)

efithypoxia <- eBayes(fithypoxia)

summary(decideTests(efithypoxia, adjust.method = "BH"))

rna_compALLhypoxia <- topTable(efithypoxia, n=Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
rna_comphypoxia <- subset(rna_compALLhypoxia, rna_compALLhypoxia$adj.P.Val<0.05)
```

#Physiological data  (Fig 1b, 1c, 1d, and 1e)
```{r}
hypoxia_physiological_data <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("data/Trialdatahypoxia.xlsx")

hypoxia_physiological_data <- hypoxia_physiological_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(Condition %in% c("NU", "NR", "HY"))


hypoxia_physiological_lactate <- hypoxia_physiological_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(Measure == "Lac")

lmm_Lac <- lmer(
  Value ~ Time * Condition + (1 | ID),
  data = hypoxia_physiological_lactate
)

summary(lmm_Lac)

emm_Lac_condition <- emmeans(lmm_Lac, ~ Condition | Time)

contrast_Lac_condition <- pairs(
  emm_Lac_condition,
  adjust = "holm"
)

summary(contrast_Lac_condition)

emm_Lac_time <- emmeans(lmm_Lac, ~ Time | Condition)

contrast_Lac_time <- contrast(
  emm_Lac_time,
  method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
  ref = "PRE",
  adjust = "holm"
)

summary(contrast_Lac_time)


hypoxia_physiological_glucose <- hypoxia_physiological_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(Measure == "Glu")

lmm_Glu <- lmer(
  Value ~ Time * Condition + (1 | ID),
  data = hypoxia_physiological_glucose
)

summary(lmm_Glu)

emm_Glu_condition <- emmeans(lmm_Glu, ~ Condition | Time)

contrast_Glu_condition <- pairs(
  emm_Glu_condition,
  adjust = "holm"
)

summary(contrast_Glu_condition)

emm_Glu_time <- emmeans(lmm_Glu, ~ Time | Condition)

contrast_Glu_time <- contrast(
  emm_Glu_time,
  method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
  ref = "PRE",
  adjust = "holm"
)

summary(contrast_Glu_time)

sampledatahypoxia_long <- sampledatahypoxia %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = 6:12,
    names_to = "Measure",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(condition == "HY" & Measure == "wpeaksession")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(condition == "NR" & Measure == "wpeakHYsession")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(condition == "NS" & Measure == "wpeaksession")) %>%
  mutate(Measure = ifelse(Measure == "wpeakHYsession", "wpeaksession", Measure)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(time == "PRE")

sampledatahypoxia_long <- sampledatahypoxia_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Measure, values_from = Value) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(percentage = dplyr::case_when(
    condition == "HY" ~ (wpeaksession / wpeakHY) * 100,
    condition %in% c("NR", "NS") ~ (wpeaksession / wpeak) * 100,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(wpeak, wpeakHY, wpeaksession, percentage, Hrpercentage),
    names_to = "Measure",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(Value = ifelse(Measure == "Hrpercentage", Value * 100, Value))

hypoxia_physiological_Wpeak <- sampledatahypoxia_long %>% dplyr::filter(Measure == "wpeaksession")

lmm_resultWpeak <- lmer(Value ~ condition + (1 | sampleid), data = hypoxia_physiological_Wpeak)
summary(lmm_resultWpeak)

multiplecomparisonsWpeak <- emmeans(lmm_resultWpeak , ~ condition)
multiplecomparisonsWpeak <- summary(pairs(multiplecomparisonsWpeak), adjust = "tukey")

hypoxia_physiological_data_sum2 <- hypoxia_physiological_Wpeak %>%
  group_by(condition, Measure) %>%
  summarize(Average = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), 
            Stdev = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

hypoxia_physiological_data_sum2$condition <- factor(hypoxia_physiological_data_sum2$condition, levels = c("NS","HY", "NR"))

pval_HY_NR <- multiplecomparisonsWpeak %>%
  summary() %>%
  dplyr::filter(contrast == "HY - NR") %>%
  dplyr::pull(p.value)

p_label1 <- ifelse(pval_HY_NR < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", signif(pval_HY_NR, 3)))

pval_NA_NR <- multiplecomparisonsWpeak %>%
  summary() %>%
  dplyr::filter(contrast == "NR - NS") %>%
  dplyr::pull(p.value)

p_label2 <- ifelse(pval_HY_NR < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", signif(pval_NA_NR, 3)))

ggplot(hypoxia_physiological_Wpeak, 
       aes(x = condition, y = Value, fill = condition, colour = condition)) +
  geom_errorbar(data = hypoxia_physiological_data_sum2,
                aes(x = condition, ymin = Average - Stdev, ymax = Average + Stdev), 
                width = 0.2, size = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(data = hypoxia_physiological_data_sum2,
               aes(x = as.numeric(factor(condition)) - 0.35, 
                   xend = as.numeric(factor(condition)) + 0.35,
                   y = Average, yend = Average),
               color = "black", size = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_quasirandom(shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 1.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression("Power output (W)"), 
       colour = "Time point", shape = "Condition") +
  
  scale_y_break(c(50, 100)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0)), 
                     limits = c(0, 340), 
                     breaks = seq(0, 320, by = 40)) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("HY" = "HY",
                              "NS" = "NA",
                              "NR" = "NR")) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("HY" = "#fcd703",
                               "NS" = "#2980b9",
                               "NR" = "#7ffa86"),
                    labels = c("HY" = "Hypoxia",
                               "NS" = "Normoxia absolute",
                               "NR" = "Normoxia relative")) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("HY" = "#3CDFE0",
                                 "NS" = "black",
                                 "NR" = "black")) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.y.left = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.y.right = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y.right = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black", size = 1),
    axis.line.y.left = element_line(color = "black", size = 1)
  ) +  
  
  ggtitle("Power output during HIIE") +
  
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("HY", "NR")),
              annotations = p_label1,
              colour = "black",
              y_position = max(hypoxia_physiological_Wpeak$Value) + 15,
              tip_length = 0.05,
              textsize = 4) +
   geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("NS", "NR")),
              annotations = p_label2,
              colour = "black",
              y_position = max(hypoxia_physiological_Wpeak$Value) + 40,
              tip_length = 0.05,
              textsize = 4)

hypoxia_physiological_data_sum2 <- hypoxia_physiological_data %>%
  group_by(Time, Condition, Measure) %>%
  summarize(Average = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), 
            Stdev = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

hypoxia_physiological_data_sum2$Time <- factor(hypoxia_physiological_data_sum2$Time, levels = c("PRE", "POST", "H3", "H24"))
hypoxia_physiological_data_sum2$Condition <- factor(hypoxia_physiological_data_sum2$Condition, levels = c("NU","HY", "NR"))

labels_df <- data.frame(
  Time = "POST",
  Average = 14,
```

#CV of CPMs at each time point across all participants (Supp Fig 1b)
```{r}
CVfunction <- function(yhypoxia) {
  
  all_genes <- rownames(rna_compALLhypoxia)
  participant_ids <- unique(sampledatahypoxia$samepleid)
  
  yhypoxiaCPM <- cpm(yhypoxia, normalized.lib.sizes = TRUE)
  
  features <- data.frame(gene = character(length(all_genes)),
                         timePRENACV = numeric(length(all_genes)),
                         timePOSTNACV = numeric(length(all_genes)),
                         time3NACV = numeric(length(all_genes)),
                         time24NACV = numeric(length(all_genes)),
                         timePRENRCV = numeric(length(all_genes)),
                         timePOSTNRCV = numeric(length(all_genes)),
                         time3NRCV = numeric(length(all_genes)),
                         time24NRCV = numeric(length(all_genes)),
                         timePREHYCV = numeric(length(all_genes)),
                         timePOSTHYCV = numeric(length(all_genes)),
                         time3HYCV = numeric(length(all_genes)),
                         time24HYCV = numeric(length(all_genes)),
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  calculate_cv <- function(data) {
    if (length(data) > 1) {
      return(sd(data) / mean(data) * 100)
    } else {
      return(NA)
    }
  }
  
  for (i in seq_along(all_genes)) {
    gene <- all_genes[i]
    
    data <- data.frame(
      sampleidhypoxia = sampleidhypoxia,
      grouphypoxia = grouphypoxia,
      condition = condition,
      counts = yhypoxiaCPM[gene, ]
    )

    aggregated_data <- data %>%
      group_by(sampleidhypoxia, grouphypoxia, condition) %>%
      summarise(counts = mean(counts, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

    genedata <- aggregated_data %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = c(grouphypoxia, condition), values_from = counts)

    features[i, ] <- list(
      gene = gene,
      timePRENACV = calculate_cv(genedata$PRE_NS),
      timePOSTNACV = calculate_cv(genedata$POST_NS),
      time3NACV = calculate_cv(genedata$H3_NS),
      time24NACV = calculate_cv(genedata$H24_NS),
      timePRENRCV = calculate_cv(genedata$PRE_NR),
      timePOSTNRCV = calculate_cv(genedata$POST_NR),
      time3NRCV = calculate_cv(genedata$H3_NR),
      time24NRCV = calculate_cv(genedata$H24_NR),
      timePREHYCV = calculate_cv(genedata$PRE_HY),
      timePOSTHYCV = calculate_cv(genedata$POST_HY),
      time3HYCV = calculate_cv(genedata$H3_HY),
      time24HYCV = calculate_cv(genedata$H24_HY)
    )
  }
  
  return(features)
}

CVhypoxiacpm <- CVfunction(yhypoxia)
```

#Volcano plots of PRE vs PRE comparisons (Supplementary Fig 1c)
```{r}
treat <- function(coef, efit) {
  result <- topTreat(efit, coef = coef, n = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
  return(result)
}

Baseline_HYvsNA  <- treat(14, efithypoxia)
Baseline_NRvsNA  <- treat(15, efithypoxia)
Baseline_HYvsNR  <- treat(16, efithypoxia)

volcano_plot <- function(data, title = "", lim1, lim2, lim3,
                         show_y_axis = TRUE) {

  p <- ggplot(
    data,
    aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(adj.P.Val), fill = adj.P.Val)
  ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5) +
    
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(0.05),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      name = "Adjusted p-value",
      colours = c("red", "blue"),
      limits = c(0, 0.05),
      breaks = seq(0.01, 0.05, by = 0.01),
      na.value = "black"
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0)),
      limits = c(lim1, lim2),
      breaks = seq(lim1, lim2, by = lim3)
    ) +
    
    theme_classic() +
    
    labs(
      x = expression("log"[2] * "FC"),
      y = expression("-log"[10] * "(adjusted p-value)"),
      title = title
    ) +
    
    theme(
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5)
    )

  if (!show_y_axis) {
    p <- p +
      theme(
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
      )
  }

  return(p)
}

p1 <- volcano_plot(
  Baseline_HYvsNA,
  "PRE (HY) vs. PRE (NA)",
  -8, 6, 2
) +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(5, 20, 5, 5)
  )

p2 <- volcano_plot(

) +

    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),

  )

p3 <- volcano_plot(
  Baseline_HYvsNR,
  "PRE (HY) vs. PRE (NR)",
  -8, 6, 2
) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 20)
  )

combined_plot <- p1 + p2 + p3 +
  plot_layout(
    nrow = 1,
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

combined_plot <- p1 +
```

#no. DE genes at each time point relative to PRE (Fig 2b)
```{r}
top_treat <- function(coef, efit) {
  result <- topTreat(efit, coef = coef, n = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
  result <- subset(result, result$adj.P.Val < 0.05)
  
  n_log2fc_0.5 <- sum(abs(result$logFC) > 0.5)
  n_log2fc_1 <- sum(abs(result$logFC) > 1)
  
  cat("DEGs (FDR < 0.05):", nrow(result), "\n")
  cat("DEGs with |log2FC| > 0.5:", n_log2fc_0.5, "\n")
  cat("DEGs with |log2FC| > 1:", n_log2fc_1, "\n\n")
  
  return(result)
}

POSTvsPRENA  <- top_treat(1, efithypoxia)
H3vsPRENA  <- top_treat(2, efithypoxia)
H24vsPRENA  <- top_treat(3, efithypoxia)
POSTvsPRENR  <- top_treat(4, efithypoxia)
H3vsPRENR  <- top_treat(5, efithypoxia)
H24vsPRENR  <- top_treat(6, efithypoxia)
POSTvsPREHY  <- top_treat(7, efithypoxia)
H3vsPREHY  <- top_treat(8, efithypoxia)
H24vsPREHY  <- top_treat(9, efithypoxia)
  
process_DE_genes <- function(data, time_point, condition) {
  
  DE_down <- data %>% dplyr::filter(logFC < 0)
  meanlogFCdown <- as.numeric(mean(DE_down$logFC))
  sdlogFCdown <-  as.numeric(sd(DE_down$logFC))
  DE_down <- rownames(DE_down)
  
  DE_down <- length(DE_down)
  DE_down <- DE_down %>% as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(Direction = "Down", Time = time_point) %>%
    cbind(meanlogFCdown) %>% cbind(sdlogFCdown)
  colnames(DE_down) <- c("Genes", "Direction", "Time", "meanlogFC", "sdlogFC")
  DE_down$Genes <- -DE_down$Genes
  
  DE_up <- data %>% dplyr::filter(logFC > 0)
  meanlogFCup <- as.numeric(mean(DE_up$logFC))
  sdlogFCup <-  as.numeric(sd(DE_up$logFC))
  DE_up <- rownames(DE_up)
  
  DE_up <- length(DE_up)
  DE_up <- DE_up %>% as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(Direction = "Up", Time = time_point) %>%
    cbind(meanlogFCup) %>% cbind(sdlogFCup)
  colnames(DE_up) <- c("Genes", "Direction", "Time", "meanlogFC", "sdlogFC")
  
  
  DE_data <- rbind(DE_down, DE_up)
  DE_data <- DE_data %>% mutate(Condition = condition)
  
  return(DE_data)
}

TotalDE1 <- process_DE_genes(POSTvsPRENA, "POST", "NA")
TotalDE2 <- process_DE_genes(H3vsPRENA, "H3", "NA")
TotalDE3 <- process_DE_genes(H24vsPRENA, "H24", "NA")
TotalDE4 <- process_DE_genes(POSTvsPRENR, "POST", "NR")
TotalDE5 <- process_DE_genes(H3vsPRENR, "H3", "NR")
TotalDE6 <- process_DE_genes(H24vsPRENR, "H24", "NR")
TotalDE7 <- process_DE_genes(POSTvsPREHY, "POST", "HY")
TotalDE8 <- process_DE_genes(H3vsPREHY, "H3", "HY")
TotalDE9 <- process_DE_genes(H24vsPREHY, "H24", "HY")

TotalDE <- rbind (TotalDE1, TotalDE2, TotalDE3, TotalDE4, TotalDE5, TotalDE6, TotalDE7, TotalDE8, TotalDE9)

TotalDE$Time <- as.character(TotalDE$Time)
TotalDE$Time <- factor(TotalDE$Time, levels = unique(TotalDE$Time))

TotalDE$Condition <- as.character(TotalDE$Condition)
TotalDE$Condition <- factor(TotalDE$Condition, levels = unique(TotalDE$Condition))

TotalDE <- TotalDE %>%
```

```{r}
#extract individual comparisons
top_treat <- function(coef, efit) {
    result <- topTreat(efit, coef = coef, n = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
    result <- subset(result, result$adj.P.Val < 0.05)
    return(result)
  }
```

#Single genes for hypoxia (Fig 2d and 2e)
```{r}
singlegenehypoxia <- function(gene) {
  
    genedata <- as.data.frame(efithypoxia$EList$E)
    genedata <- efithypoxia$EList$E[rownames(efithypoxia$EList$E) == gene, , drop = FALSE]

    expression_df <- as.data.frame(t(genedata))
    colnames(expression_df) <- "log2FC"

    expression_df <- expression_df %>%
      rownames_to_column("colname") %>%
      mutate(colname = as.character(colname)) %>%
      extract(
              colname, 
              into = c("Condition", "Participant_code", "Time_point"),
              regex = "^(\\D{2})(\\d{1,2})(B|P\\d+)_.*$")

    expression_df <- expression_df %>%
      group_by(Condition, Participant_code) %>%
      mutate(log2FC_B = log2FC[Time_point == "B"]) %>%

      mutate(log2FC = log2FC - log2FC_B) %>%

      dplyr::select(-log2FC_B) %>%
      dplyr::filter(Time_point != "B") %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(gene = gene)
    
    expression_df <- merge(
        expression_df,
        sampledatahypoxia[, c("ID", "vo2")],
              by.x = "Participant_code", by.y = "ID",
              all.x = FALSE
          )

      expression_df <- expression_df %>%
      distinct()

      expression_df <- expression_df %>%
        group_by(Time_point, Condition, gene) %>%
        summarize(
              mean_log2FC = mean(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd_log2FC = sd(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop"
         )
      
   expression_df <- expression_df %>%
  mutate(
    Regulation = case_when(
      Condition == "HY" & Time_point == "P0" & gene %in% rownames(POSTvsPREHY) ~ ifelse(POSTvsPREHY[gene, "logFC"] > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
      Condition == "HY" & Time_point == "P3" & gene %in% rownames(H3vsPREHY) ~ ifelse(H3vsPREHY[gene, "logFC"] > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
      Condition == "HY" & Time_point == "P24" & gene %in% rownames(H24vsPREHY) ~ ifelse(H24vsPREHY[gene, "logFC"] > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),

      Condition == "NA" & Time_point == "P0" & gene %in% rownames(POSTvsPRENA) ~ ifelse(POSTvsPRENA[gene, "logFC"] > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
      Condition == "NA" & Time_point == "P3" & gene %in% rownames(H3vsPRENA) ~ ifelse(H3vsPRENA[gene, "logFC"] > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
      Condition == "NA" & Time_point == "P24" & gene %in% rownames(H24vsPRENA) ~ ifelse(H24vsPRENA[gene, "logFC"] > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),

      Condition == "NR" & Time_point == "P0" & gene %in% rownames(POSTvsPRENR) ~ ifelse(POSTvsPRENR[gene, "logFC"] > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
      Condition == "NR" & Time_point == "P3" & gene %in% rownames(H3vsPRENR) ~ ifelse(H3vsPRENR[gene, "logFC"] > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
      Condition == "NR" & Time_point == "P24" & gene %in% rownames(H24vsPRENR) ~ ifelse(H24vsPRENR[gene, "logFC"] > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
      TRUE ~ "Not DE"
    ),
    
    adj.P.Val = case_when(
      Condition == "HY" & Time_point == "P0" & gene %in% rownames(POSTvsPREHY) ~ POSTvsPREHY[gene, "adj.P.Val"],
      Condition == "HY" & Time_point == "P3" & gene %in% rownames(H3vsPREHY) ~ H3vsPREHY[gene, "adj.P.Val"],
      Condition == "HY" & Time_point == "P24" & gene %in% rownames(H24vsPREHY) ~ H24vsPREHY[gene, "adj.P.Val"],

      Condition == "NA" & Time_point == "P0" & gene %in% rownames(POSTvsPRENA) ~ POSTvsPRENA[gene, "adj.P.Val"],
      Condition == "NA" & Time_point == "P3" & gene %in% rownames(H3vsPRENA) ~ H3vsPRENA[gene, "adj.P.Val"],
      Condition == "NA" & Time_point == "P24" & gene %in% rownames(H24vsPRENA) ~ H24vsPRENA[gene, "adj.P.Val"],

      Condition == "NR" & Time_point == "P0" & gene %in% rownames(POSTvsPRENR) ~ POSTvsPRENR[gene, "adj.P.Val"],
      Condition == "NR" & Time_point == "P3" & gene %in% rownames(H3vsPRENR) ~ H3vsPRENR[gene, "adj.P.Val"],
      Condition == "NR" & Time_point == "P24" & gene %in% rownames(H24vsPRENR) ~ H24vsPRENR[gene, "adj.P.Val"],
      TRUE ~ 1
    ),
    type = "gene expression"
  )
  
  return(expression_df)
}

plot_gene_expression_faceted <- function(gene_id, gene_symbol, lim1, lim2, seq1) {

  df <- singlegenehypoxia(gene_id)

  df$Condition <- factor(df$Condition, levels = c("NA", "HY", "NR"))
  df$Time_point <- factor(df$Time_point, levels = c("P0", "P3", "P24"),
                          labels = c("+0 h", "+3 h", "+24 h"))
  df$Regulation <- factor(df$Regulation, levels = c("Upregulated", "Not DE", "Downregulated"))

  condition_background <- strip_nested(
    text_x = elem_list_text(colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    background_x = elem_list_rect(
      fill = c(
        "NA" = "#3498db",
        "HY" = "#fcd703",
        "NR" = "#7ffa86"
      )
    )
  )

  ggplot(df, aes(y = mean_log2FC, x = Time_point, fill = Condition, group = Condition)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "NA" = "#3498db",
      "HY" = "#fcd703",
      "NR" = "#7ffa86"
    )) +
    new_scale_fill() +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0), colour = "black", size = 1) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = mean_log2FC + sd_log2FC,
                      ymin = mean_log2FC - sd_log2FC,
                      colour = Condition),
                  width = 0.25, size = 0.75,
                  show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(
      "NA" = "#3498db",
      "HY" = "#fcd703",
      "NR" = "#7ffa86"
    ), name = "Condition") +
    geom_point(aes(y = mean_log2FC, x = Time_point,
                   fill = adj.P.Val, group = Condition, colour = Condition),
               shape = 21, size = 4, show.legend = FALSE, inherit.aes = FALSE, stroke = 2) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(name = "Adjusted p-value", colours = c("red", "blue"),
                         limits = c(0, 0.05), breaks = seq(0.01, 0.05, by = 0.01),
                         na.value = "black") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = bquote(Log[2]*FC ~ "relative to PRE")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
```

#Shared across all groups enrichment (Fig. 3a)
```{r}
Pull_together_timepointsDOWN <- function(data1, data2, data3, interaction) {
 
  genes_data1 <- rownames(data1[data1$logFC < 0, ])
  genes_data2 <- rownames(data2[data2$logFC < 0, ])
  genes_data3 <- rownames(data3[data3$logFC < 0, ])

  unique_genes <- Reduce(interaction, list(genes_data1, genes_data2, genes_data3))

  filtered_rna_comp <- data1[rownames(data1) %in% unique_genes, ]
  
  DE_data <- rownames(filtered_rna_comp)
   return(DE_data)
}

Pull_together_timepointsUP <- function(data1, data2, data3, interaction) {
 
  genes_data1 <- rownames(data1[data1$logFC > 0, ])
  genes_data2 <- rownames(data2[data2$logFC > 0, ])
  genes_data3 <- rownames(data3[data3$logFC > 0, ])

  unique_genes <- Reduce(interaction, list(genes_data1, genes_data2, genes_data3))

  filtered_rna_comp <- data1[rownames(data1) %in% unique_genes, ]
  
  DE_data <- rownames(filtered_rna_comp)
   return(DE_data)
}

hypoxia_exercise_enrich <- function(specificgenestime_point, allgenestime_point, time_point, group, direction) {

  if(length(specificgenestime_point) < 10) {
  
    return(data.frame(Time = time_point, Direction = direction, Group = group, Description = 	"protein folding",
                      ID = NA, GeneRatio = NA, BgRatio = NA, pvalue = NA, p.adjust = NA, qvalue = NA,zScore = NA, FoldEnrichment = NA, RichFactor = NA,
                      geneID = NA, Count = NA))
  }
  
  setenrichment <- enrichGO(specificgenestime_point, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db",
                            universe = rownames(allgenestime_point), keyType = "ENSEMBL",
                            ont = "BP", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                            pAdjustMethod = "BH", readable = FALSE, pool = FALSE)
  
  #check if setenrichment is NULL
  if (is.null(setenrichment)) {
    return(data.frame(Time = time_point, Direction = direction, Group = group, Description = "No enrichment",
                      ID = NA, GeneRatio = NA, BgRatio = NA, pvalue = NA, p.adjust = NA, qvalue = NA, zScore = NA, FoldEnrichment = NA, RichFactor = NA,
                      geneID = NA, Count = NA))
  }
  
  setenrichment  <- as.data.frame(setenrichment@result) %>%
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    mutate(Time = time_point, Direction = direction, Group = group)
  
  return(setenrichment)
}
```

#Ridge plot (all shared genes) (Fig. 3b)
```{r}
add_metadata <- function(df, time, condition) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      gene = rownames(df),
      Time = time,
      Condition = condition
    )
}

combine_timepoint <- function(df_list, time) {
  shared_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(df_list, rownames))
  
  combined <- bind_rows(
    lapply(names(df_list), function(cond) {
      add_metadata(df_list[[cond]][shared_genes, ], time, cond)
    })
  )
  return(combined)
}

combined_df <- bind_rows(
  combine_timepoint(list("NA" = POSTvsPRENA, "NR" = POSTvsPRENR, "HY" = POSTvsPREHY), "+0 h"),
  combine_timepoint(list("NA" = H3vsPRENA, "NR" = H3vsPRENR, "HY" = H3vsPREHY), "+3 h"),
  combine_timepoint(list("NA" = H24vsPRENA, "NR" = H24vsPRENR, "HY" = H24vsPREHY), "+24 h")
)

combined_df <- combined_df %>% dplyr::filter(Time != "+0 h")

time_background <- strip_nested(
  text_y = elem_list_text(colour = "black", face = "bold"),
  background_y = elem_list_rect(
    fill = c(
        "+3 h" = "lightgrey", 
        "+24 h" = "darkgrey")))

combined_df$Time <- factor(combined_df$Time, levels = c("+3 h", "+24 h"))

gene_counts <- combined_df %>%
  mutate(Direction = if_else(logFC < 0, "Down", "Up")) %>%
  group_by(Time, Condition, Direction) %>%
  summarise(gene_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0("No. DEGs: ", gene_count),
    x = if_else(Direction == "Down", -1.75, 3),
    y = 0.7
  )

combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  mutate(Direction = case_when(
    logFC > 0 ~ "Up",
    logFC < 0 ~ "Down",
    TRUE ~ "NoChange"
  ))

anova_contrasts <- combined_df %>%
  group_by(Time, Direction) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    fit <- aov(logFC ~ Condition, data = .x)
    emmeans_fit <- emmeans(fit, specs = "Condition")
    
    contrast(emmeans_fit, method = "pairwise") %>%
      summary(adjust = "holm") %>%
      as.data.frame() 
  })

annotations <- data.frame(
  logFC = c(-0.8, 0.8),
  y = c(0.5, 0.7),
  Time = "+24 h",
  label = "*"
)

combined_df$Condition <- factor(combined_df$Condition, levels = c("NA", "HY", "NR"))

annotations$Time <- factor(annotations$Time, levels = levels(combined_df$Time))

ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = logFC, colour = Condition)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), colour = "black", size = 0.5) +

               stat = "density",

            aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, group = Condition),
```

```{r}
ENRICHMENT_individual_timepointsUP <- function(data1, data2, interaction) {
  
  genes_data1 <- rownames(data1[data1$logFC > 0, ])
  genes_data2 <- rownames(data2[data2$logFC > 0, ])

  unique_genes <- interaction(genes_data1, genes_data2)
  
   return(unique_genes)
}

ENRICHMENT_individual_timepointsDOWN <- function(data1, data2, interaction) {
 
  genes_data1 <- rownames(data1[data1$logFC < 0, ])
  genes_data2 <- rownames(data2[data2$logFC < 0, ])

  unique_genes <- interaction(genes_data1, genes_data2)
  
   return(unique_genes)
}

hypoxia_exercise_enrich <- function(specificgenestime_point, allgenestime_point, time_point, group, direction) {

  if(length(specificgenestime_point) < 10) {
  
    return(data.frame(Time = time_point, Direction = direction, Group = group, Description = 	"ribosome biogenesis",
                      ID = NA, GeneRatio = NA, BgRatio = NA, pvalue = NA, p.adjust = NA, qvalue = NA, RichFactor = NA, FoldEnrichment = NA, zScore = NA,
                      geneID = NA, Count = NA))
  }
  
  enrichframe <- enrichGO(specificgenestime_point, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db",
                            universe = allgenestime_point, keyType = "ENSEMBL",
                            ont = "BP", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                            pAdjustMethod = "BH", readable = FALSE, pool = FALSE)
  
  if (is.null(enrichframe)) {
    return(data.frame(Time = time_point, Direction = direction, Group = group, Description = "ribosome biogenesis",
                      ID = NA, GeneRatio = NA, BgRatio = NA, pvalue = NA, p.adjust = NA, qvalue = NA,
                      geneID = NA, Count = NA))
  }
  
  enrichframe  <- as.data.frame(enrichframe@result) %>%
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    mutate(Time = time_point, Direction = direction, Group = group)
  
  return(enrichframe)
}
```

#Ridge plot for intensity-specific exercise (Fig. 3d)
```{r}
add_metadata <- function(df, time, condition) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      gene = rownames(df),
      Time = time,
      Condition = condition
    )
}

combine_timepoint <- function(df_list, time, na_genes) {
  shared_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(df_list, rownames))
  keep_genes <- setdiff(shared_genes, na_genes)
  
  bind_rows(
    lapply(names(df_list), function(cond) {
      add_metadata(df_list[[cond]][keep_genes, ], time, cond)
    })
  )
}

na_lists <- list(
  "+0 h"  = rownames(POSTvsPRENA),
  "+3 h"  = rownames(H3vsPRENA),
  "+24 h" = rownames(H24vsPRENA)
)

combined_df <- bind_rows(
  combine_timepoint(
    list("NR" = POSTvsPRENR, "HY" = POSTvsPREHY),
    "+0 h",
    na_lists[["+0 h"]]
  ),
  combine_timepoint(
    list("NR" = H3vsPRENR, "HY" = H3vsPREHY),
    "+3 h",
    na_lists[["+3 h"]]
  ),
  combine_timepoint(
    list("NR" = H24vsPRENR, "HY" = H24vsPREHY),
    "+24 h",
    na_lists[["+24 h"]]
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Time != "+0 h")

combined_df$Time <- factor(combined_df$Time, levels = c("+3 h", "+24 h"))

gene_direction <- combined_df %>%
  group_by(Time, gene) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_logFC = mean(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    Direction = case_when(
      mean_logFC > 0 ~ "Up",
      mean_logFC < 0 ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "NoChange"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  left_join(gene_direction, by = c("Time", "gene"))

gene_counts <- combined_df %>%
  group_by(Time, Condition, Direction) %>%
  summarise(gene_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0("No. DEGs: ", gene_count),
    x = if_else(Direction == "Down", -2.2, 3),
    y = 0.7
  )

anova_contrasts <- combined_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Direction %in% c("Up", "Down")) %>%
  group_by(Time, Direction) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    fit <- aov(logFC ~ Condition, data = .x)
    emmeans_fit <- emmeans(fit, specs = "Condition")
    
    contrast(emmeans_fit, method = "pairwise") %>%
      summary(adjust = "holm") %>%
      as.data.frame()
  })

annotations <- data.frame(
  logFC = c(-0.6, 0.6),
  y = c(0.65, 0.65),
  Time = "+24 h",
  label = "*"
)

combined_df$Condition <- factor(combined_df$Condition, levels = c("HY", "NR"))

annotations$Time <- factor(annotations$Time, levels = levels(combined_df$Time))

ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = logFC, colour = Condition)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), colour = "black", size = 0.5) +
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(density), colour = Condition), 
               stat = "density", 
               position = "identity",
               size = 1,
               show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_text(data = gene_counts, 
            aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, group = Condition), 
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 4) +
  geom_text(data = annotations,
            aes(x = logFC, y = y, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 10,
            colour = "black") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("HY" = "#fcd703", "NA" = "#3498db", "NR" = "#7ffa86")) +
  labs(
    x = bquote(Log[2] * FC ~ "relative to PRE"),
    fill = NULL,
    colour = NULL,
    y = bquote("Density")
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, vjust = 1.5, angle = 90),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_markdown(size = 18, hjust = 0.6),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA)
  ) +
  ggtitle("Magnitude of differential expression<br>for <b>intensity-specific</b> DEGs") +
  facet_nested(
    Time ~ .,

    breaks = seq(0.2, 0.8, by = 0.2)
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = NA, shape = 16, linetype = 1)))
```

```{r}
ENRICHMENT_individual_timepointsUP <- function(data1, data2, data3, interaction) {
  
  genes_data1 <- rownames(data1[data1$logFC > 0, ])
  genes_data2 <- rownames(data2[data2$logFC > 0, ])
  genes_data3 <- rownames(data3[data3$logFC > 0, ])

  unique_genes <- interaction(genes_data1, c(genes_data2, genes_data3))
  
  filtered_rna_comp <- data1[rownames(data1) %in% unique_genes, ]

  DE_data <- rownames(filtered_rna_comp)
   return(DE_data)
}

ENRICHMENT_individual_timepointsDOWN <- function(data1, data2, data3, interaction) {
 
  genes_data1 <- rownames(data1[data1$logFC < 0, ])
  genes_data2 <- rownames(data2[data2$logFC < 0, ])
  genes_data3 <- rownames(data3[data3$logFC < 0, ])

  unique_genes <- interaction(genes_data1, c(genes_data2, genes_data3))
  
  filtered_rna_comp <- data1[rownames(data1) %in% unique_genes, ]
  
  DE_data <- rownames(filtered_rna_comp)
   return(DE_data)
}

hypoxia_exercise_enrich <- function(specificgenestime_point, allgenestime_point, time_point, group, direction) {

  if(length(specificgenestime_point) < 10) {
  
    return(data.frame(Time = time_point, Direction = direction, Group = group, Description = 	"cristae formation",
                      ID = NA, GeneRatio = NA, BgRatio = NA, pvalue = NA, p.adjust = NA, qvalue = NA, RichFactor = NA, FoldEnrichment = NA, zScore = NA,
                      geneID = NA, Count = NA))
  }
  
  enrichframe <- enrichGO(specificgenestime_point, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db",
                            universe = rownames(allgenestime_point), keyType = "ENSEMBL",
                            ont = "BP", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                            pAdjustMethod = "BH", readable = FALSE, pool = FALSE)
  
  if (is.null(enrichframe)) {
    return(data.frame(Time = time_point, Direction = direction, Group = group, Description = "No enrichment",
                      ID = NA, GeneRatio = NA, BgRatio = NA, pvalue = NA, p.adjust = NA, qvalue = NA,
                      geneID = NA, Count = NA))
  }
  
  enrichframe  <- as.data.frame(enrichframe@result) %>%
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    mutate(Time = time_point, Direction = direction, Group = group)
  
  return(enrichframe)
}
```

#Mitochondrial pathways (profile plots) (Fig 4a-d)
```{r}
treat <- function(coef, efit) {
    result <- topTreat(efit, coef = coef, n = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
    return(result)
  }
  
POSTvsPRENAall  <- treat(1, efithypoxia)
H3vsPRENAall  <- treat(2, efithypoxia)
H24vsPRENAall  <- treat(3, efithypoxia)
POSTvsPRENRall  <- treat(4, efithypoxia)
H3vsPRENRall  <- treat(5, efithypoxia)
H24vsPRENRall  <- treat(6, efithypoxia)
POSTvsPREHYall  <- treat(7, efithypoxia)
H3vsPREHYall  <- treat(8, efithypoxia)
H24vsPREHYall  <- treat(9, efithypoxia)

plot_mito_density <- function(GOBPterm, pathwayname, which_counts, lim1, lim2, break1, break2, break3, logfc1, logfc2, y1, y2, time1, time2) {
  
  add_metadata <- function(df, time, condition) {
    df$gene <- rownames(df)
    df$Time <- time
    df$Condition <- condition
    return(df)
  }
  
  combined_df <- rbind(
    add_metadata(H3vsPRENAall, "+3 h", "NA"),
    add_metadata(H3vsPRENRall, "+3 h", "NR"),
    add_metadata(H3vsPREHYall, "+3 h", "HY"),
    add_metadata(H24vsPRENAall, "+24 h", "NA"),
    add_metadata(H24vsPRENRall, "+24 h", "NR"),
    add_metadata(H24vsPREHYall, "+24 h", "HY")
  )
  
  combined_df$Time <- factor(combined_df$Time, levels = c("+3 h", "+24 h"))
  
  mito_genes <- as.data.frame(mget(c(GOBPterm),org.Hs.egGO2ALLEGS))

  mito_genes <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "entrezgene_id", "external_gene_name"),
                        filters = "entrezgene_id",
                        values = mito_genes[[1]],
                        mart = mart)

  mito_genes <- mito_genes$ensembl_gene_id
  
  print(length(unique(mito_genes)))
   
  combined_df <- combined_df %>% dplyr::filter(gene %in% mito_genes)
  
  gene_counts1 <- combined_df %>%
    mutate(Direction = if_else(logFC < 0, "Down", "Up")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
    group_by(Time, Condition, Direction) %>%
    summarise(gene_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      label = paste0("No. DEGs: ", gene_count),
      x_pos = if_else(Direction == "Up", 0.75, -0.75),
      y_base = if_else(Direction == "Up", 2, 2),
      y_offset = case_when(
        Condition == "HY" ~ 0,
        Condition == "NA" ~ 0.4,
        Condition == "NR" ~ -0.4
      ),
      y_pos = y_base + y_offset
    )
  
  combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  mutate(Direction = case_when(
    logFC > 0 ~ "Up",
    logFC < 0 ~ "Down",
    TRUE ~ "NoChange"
  ))

  anova_contrasts <- combined_df %>%
    group_by(Time) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      fit <- aov(logFC ~ Condition, data = .x)
      emmeans_fit <- emmeans(fit, specs = "Condition")
      
      contrast(emmeans_fit, method = "pairwise") %>%
        summary(adjust = "holm") %>%
        as.data.frame() 
    })
  
  print(anova_contrasts)
  
  annotations <- data.frame(
    logFC = c(logfc1, logfc2),
    y = c(y1, y2),
    Time = c(time1, time2),
    label = "*"
  )
  
    gene_counts2 <- combined_df %>%
    mutate(Direction = if_else(logFC < 0, "Down", "Up")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
    group_by(Time, Condition, Direction) %>%
    summarise(gene_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      label = paste0("No. DEGs: ", gene_count),
      x_pos = if_else(Direction == "Up", 0.75, -0.8),
      y_base = if_else(Direction == "Up", 2.85, 2.85),
      y_offset = case_when(
        Condition == "HY" ~ 0,
        Condition == "NA" ~ 0.4,
        Condition == "NR" ~ -0.4
      ),
      y_pos = y_base + y_offset
    )

  time_background <- strip_nested(
    text_y = elem_list_text(colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    background_y = elem_list_rect(
      fill = c(
        "+3 h" = "lightgrey", 
        "+24 h" = "darkgrey")
    )
  )
  
  counts_to_use <- if (which_counts == "counts2") gene_counts2 else gene_counts1
  
  annotations$Time <- factor(annotations$Time, levels = levels(combined_df$Time))
  
  p <- ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = logFC, colour = Condition)) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), colour = "black", size = 0.5) +
    geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(density), colour = Condition), 
               stat = "density", 
               position = "identity",
               alpha = 0.4,
               size = 1,
               show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_text(
      data = counts_to_use, 
      aes(x = x_pos, y = y_pos, label = label, colour = Condition), 
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 4,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(data = annotations,
            aes(x = logFC, y = y, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 10,
            colour = "black") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("HY" = "#fcd703", "NA" = "#3498db", "NR" = "#7ffa86")) +
    labs(
      x = bquote(Log[2] * FC ~ "relative to PRE"), 
      y = bquote("Density")
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, vjust = 1, angle = 90),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      strip.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.6),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    ) +
    ggtitle(pathwayname) +
    facet_nested(
      Time ~ ., 
      scales = "free_y",
      switch = "y", 
      strip = time_background
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.5),
      limits = c(-1, 1)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.075)),
                         limits = c(lim1, lim2),
                         breaks = seq(break1, break2, by = break3)
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
create_heatmap_for_pathway_with_all <- function(description, titleformap) {
  
  reordered_data <- rna_compALLhypoxia[c(1, 2, 3, 7, 8, 9, 4, 5, 6)]
  reordered_data$ensembl_gene_id <- rownames(reordered_data)
  
  genesymbols <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "external_gene_name"),
                       filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
                       values = reordered_data$ensembl_gene_id,
                       mart = mart)
  
  reordered_data <- merge(reordered_data, genesymbols,
                          by.x = "ensembl_gene_id", by.y = "ensembl_gene_id", all.x = TRUE)
  
  mitocarta <- read.xlsx("data/MitoCarta30RAWxl.xlsx")

  mitocartafix  <- mitocarta  %>%
  separate_rows(EnsemblGeneID_mapping_version_20200130, sep = "\\|")

  mito_genes <- mitocartafix %>%
    dplyr::filter(str_detect(MitoCarta3.0_MitoPathways, stringr::fixed(description))) %>%
    pull(EnsemblGeneID_mapping_version_20200130)

  filtered_comphypoxia <- reordered_data[reordered_data$ensembl_gene_id %in% mito_genes, ]

  rownames(filtered_comphypoxia) <- filtered_comphypoxia$external_gene_name
  
  mat <- as.matrix(filtered_comphypoxia[c(2:10)])
  
  print(nrow(mat))
  
  ordered_indices <- rev(order(mat[, 6]))
  mat <- mat[ordered_indices, ]
  filtered_comphypoxia <- filtered_comphypoxia[ordered_indices, ]
  
  labelsHM <- expression(Log[2]*FC ~ "relative to PRE")
  
  col <- colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#0A3C72", "white", "#7B0722"))
  
  hypoxialabel1 <- c(
    "POSTvsPRE.NA." = "#3498db",
    "H3vsPRE.NA." = "#3498db", 
    "H24vsPRE.NA." = "#3498db", 
    "POSTvsPRE.HY." = "#fcd703", 
    "H3vsPRE.HY." = "#fcd703", 
    "H24vsPRE.HY." = "#fcd703",
    "POSTvsPRE.NR." = "#7ffa86", 
    "H3vsPRE.NR." = "#7ffa86", 
    "H24vsPRE.NR." = "#7ffa86"
  )
  
  DE_lists <- list(
    "POSTvsPRE.NA." = rownames(POSTvsPRENA),
    "H3vsPRE.NA."   = rownames(H3vsPRENA),
    "H24vsPRE.NA."  = rownames(H24vsPRENA),
    "POSTvsPRE.NR." = rownames(POSTvsPRENR),
    "H3vsPRE.NR."   = rownames(H3vsPRENR),
    "H24vsPRE.NR."  = rownames(H24vsPRENR),
    "POSTvsPRE.HY." = rownames(POSTvsPREHY),
    "H3vsPRE.HY."   = rownames(H3vsPREHY),
    "H24vsPRE.HY."  = rownames(H24vsPREHY)
  )
  
  print(length(intersect(rownames(H24vsPREHY), mito_genes)))
  
  column_annotation1 <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    df = data.frame(
      Condition = factor(colnames(filtered_comphypoxia)[2:10], levels = c(
        "POSTvsPRE.NA.", "H3vsPRE.NA.", "H24vsPRE.NA.", 
        "POSTvsPRE.HY.", "H3vsPRE.HY.", "H24vsPRE.HY.", 
        "POSTvsPRE.NR.", "H3vsPRE.NR.", "H24vsPRE.NR."
      ))
    ),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    col = list(Condition = hypoxialabel1),
    show_legend = FALSE
  )
  
  heatmap <- Heatmap(
    mat,
    column_title = titleformap,
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = labelsHM, 
      legend_width = unit(3.6, "cm"),
      legend_direction = "horizontal"
    ),
    col = col, 
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    show_column_dend = TRUE,
    row_names_side = "left",
    show_row_dend = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE, 
    show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    column_labels = c("NA +0 h", "NA +3 h", "NA +24 h", "HY +0 h", "HY +3 h", "HY +24 h", 
                      "NR +0 h", "NR +3 h", "NR +24 h"),
    column_names_rot = 60,
    top_annotation = column_annotation1,
    
   cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    gene_id <- filtered_comphypoxia$ensembl_gene_id[i]
    colname <- colnames(mat)[j]
    if (gene_id %in% DE_lists[[colname]]) {
      new_y <- y - 0.25 * height
      grid.text(
        "*",
        x = x,
        y = new_y,
        gp = gpar(col = "black", fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
        just = "center"
      )
  }
}
  )
  
  return(grid.grabExpr(draw(heatmap)))
}
```

#Compare exercise prescriptions between Botella 2025 and this study (Supp fig 3)
```{r}
hypoxia_physiological_data <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("data/Trialdatahypoxia.xlsx")

hypoxia_physiological_lactate <- hypoxia_physiological_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(Time %in% c("PRE", "POST"), Measure == "Lac")

hypoxia_physiological_lactate$TimeCond <- interaction(hypoxia_physiological_lactate$Condition, 
                                                   hypoxia_physiological_lactate$Time, sep = "_")

lmm_Lac <- lmer(Value ~ Time * Condition + (1 | ID),
                data = hypoxia_physiological_lactate)

emm_Lac <- emmeans(lmm_Lac, ~ Time | Condition)
contrast_Lac <- pairs(emm_Lac, adjust = "holm")

contrast_df <- as.data.frame(contrast_Lac)
contrast_df$group1 <- sub(" -.*", "", contrast_df$contrast)
contrast_df$group2 <- sub(".*- ", "", contrast_df$contrast)
contrast_df <- contrast_df %>% dplyr::filter(group1 == "POST" & group2 == "PRE")

format_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("n.s.")
  if (p < 0.001) return("p < 0.001")
  paste0("p = ", signif(p, 3))
}

contrast_df$annotation <- sapply(contrast_df$p.value, format_p)

y_max <- max(hypoxia_physiological_lactate$Value)
step_height <- 0.5
contrast_df$y_position <- y_max + seq_len(nrow(contrast_df)) * step_height

lactate_summary <- hypoxia_physiological_lactate %>%
  group_by(Condition, Time) %>%
  summarize(Average = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
            Stdev   = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(TimeCond = interaction(Condition, Time, sep = "_"))

hypoxia_physiological_lactate$TimeCond <- factor(hypoxia_physiological_lactate$TimeCond,
                                               levels = c("MICE_PRE", "MICE_POST", "NU_PRE", "NU_POST", "HY_PRE", "HY_POST", "NR_PRE", "NR_POST", "SIE_PRE", "SIE_POST"))

lactate_summary$TimeCond <- factor(lactate_summary$TimeCond,
                                               levels = c("MICE_PRE", "MICE_POST", "NU_PRE", "NU_POST", "HY_PRE", "HY_POST", "NR_PRE", "NR_POST", "SIE_PRE", "SIE_POST"))

y_positions <- hypoxia_physiological_lactate %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarize(max_val = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(y_pos = max_val + seq(0.5, by = 0.5, length.out = n()))

ggplot(lactate_summary, aes(x = TimeCond, y = Average, fill = Condition, colour = Condition)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Average - Stdev, ymax = Average + Stdev),
                width = 0.2,
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = hypoxia_physiological_lactate,
            aes(x = TimeCond, y = Value, group = interaction(Condition,ID)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 0.1, colour = "grey", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = hypoxia_physiological_lactate,
             aes(x = TimeCond, y = Value, colour = Condition, fill = Condition),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 21,
             size = 2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("NU_PRE", "NU_POST")),
              annotations = contrast_df$annotation[contrast_df$Condition == "NU"],
              y_position = y_positions$y_pos[y_positions$Condition == "NU"],
              tip_length = 0.03, textsize = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("HY_PRE", "HY_POST")),
              annotations = contrast_df$annotation[contrast_df$Condition == "HY"],
              y_position = y_positions$y_pos[y_positions$Condition == "HY"],
              tip_length = 0.03, textsize = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("NR_PRE", "NR_POST")),
              annotations = contrast_df$annotation[contrast_df$Condition == "NR"],
              y_position = y_positions$y_pos[y_positions$Condition == "NR"],
              tip_length = 0.03, textsize = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("SIE_PRE", "SIE_POST")),
              annotations = contrast_df$annotation[contrast_df$Condition == "SIE"],
              y_position = y_positions$y_pos[y_positions$Condition == "SIE"],
              tip_length = 0.03, textsize = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("MICE_PRE", "MICE_POST")),
              annotations = contrast_df$annotation[contrast_df$Condition == "MICE"],
              y_position = y_positions$y_pos[y_positions$Condition == "MICE"],
              tip_length = 0.03, textsize = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = lactate_summary %>% 
              group_by(Condition) %>%
              summarize(x = mean(as.numeric(TimeCond)),
                        y = max(Average + Stdev) + 1) %>%
              mutate(ConditionLabel = ifelse(Condition == "NU", "NA", Condition)),
            aes(x = x, y = 21, label = ConditionLabel),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE,
            size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("HY" = "#fcd703",
                               "NU" = "#2980b9",
                               "NR" = "#7ffa86",
                               "SIE" = "#E709C1",
                               "MICE" = "#A77E69")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("HY" = "#3CDFE0",
                                 "NU" = "black",
                                 "NR" = "black",
                                 "SIE" = "black",
                                 "MICE" = "black")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0)), limits = c(0,22)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = rep(c("PRE", "POST"), times = 5)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression("Blood lactate concentration (mmol·L"^{-1}*")")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y.left = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.y.right = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y.right = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black", size = 1),
    axis.line.y.left = element_line(color = "black", size = 1)
  ) +
  ggtitle("Changes in blood lactate")

export::graph2doc(file="LactateBotella.docx", width=5,height=3.5)

hypoxia_physiological_Work <- hypoxia_physiological_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(Measure == "Work") %>%
  mutate(Value = Value / 1000)

hypoxia_physiological_Work$Condition <- factor(
  hypoxia_physiological_Work$Condition,
  levels = c("MICE", "NU", "HY", "NR", "SIE")
)

lmm_resultWork <- lmer(Value ~ Condition + (1 | ID), data = hypoxia_physiological_Work)
summary(lmm_resultWork)

multiplecomparisonsWork <- emmeans(lmm_resultWork , ~ Condition)

contrast_list <- list(
  "MICE - NR" = c(1, 0, 0, -1, 0),
  "SIE - NR"  = c(0, 0, 0, -1, 1),
  "MICE - HY" = c(1, 0, -1, 0, 0),
  "SIE - HY"  = c(0, 0, -1, 0, 1),
  "MICE - SIE"= c(1, 0, 0, 0, -1),
  "HY - NR"   = c(0, 0, -1, 1, 0)
)

contrast_result <- contrast(multiplecomparisonsWork, method = contrast_list, adjust = "holm")
contrast_df <- as.data.frame(contrast_result)

format_pval <- function(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) return("p < 0.001")
  paste0("p = ", signif(p, 3))
}

contrast_df$annotation <- sapply(contrast_df$p.value, format_pval)

p_label_HY_NR <- contrast_df$annotation[contrast_df$contrast == "HY - NR"]
p_label_MICE_NR <- contrast_df$annotation[contrast_df$contrast == "MICE - NR"]
p_label_SIE_NR  <- contrast_df$annotation[contrast_df$contrast == "SIE - NR"]
p_label_MICE_HY <- contrast_df$annotation[contrast_df$contrast == "MICE - HY"]
p_label_SIE_HY  <- contrast_df$annotation[contrast_df$contrast == "SIE - HY"]
p_label_MICE_SIE <- contrast_df$annotation[contrast_df$contrast == "MICE - SIE"]

hypoxia_physiological_data_sum2 <- hypoxia_physiological_Work %>%
  group_by(Condition, Measure) %>%
  summarize(Average = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), 
            Stdev = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(hypoxia_physiological_Work, 
       aes(x = Condition, y = Value, fill = Condition, colour = Condition)) +
  geom_errorbar(data = hypoxia_physiological_data_sum2,
                aes(x = Condition, ymin = Average - Stdev, ymax = Average + Stdev), 
                width = 0.2, size = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(data = hypoxia_physiological_data_sum2,
               aes(x = as.numeric(Condition) - 0.35, 
                   xend = as.numeric(Condition) + 0.35,
                   y = Average, yend = Average),
               color = "black", size = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_quasirandom(shape = 21, size = 4, stroke = 1.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression("Work (kJ)"), 
       colour = "Time point", shape = "Condition") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0)), 
                     limits = c(0, 1550), 
                     breaks = seq(0, 1400, by = 200)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("HY" = "HY",
                              "NU" = "NA",
                              "NR" = "NR",
                              "SIE" = "SIE",
                              "MICE" = "MICE")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("HY" = "#fcd703",
                               "NU" = "#2980b9",
                               "NR" = "#7ffa86",
                               "SIE" = "#E709C1",
                               "MICE" = "#A77E69")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("HY" = "#3CDFE0",
                                 "NU" = "black",
                                 "NR" = "black",
                                 "SIE" = "black",
                                 "MICE" = "black")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),

    axis.text.y.left = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.y.right = element_blank(),

    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black", size = 1),

  ) +  
  ggtitle("Exercise volume") +
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("HY", "NR")),
              annotations = p_label_HY_NR,
              colour = "black",
              y_position = 450,
              tip_length = 0.05,
              textsize = 4) +
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("MICE", "NR")),
              annotations = p_label_MICE_NR,
              colour = "black",
              y_position = 1250,
              tip_length = 0.05,

              annotations = p_label_SIE_NR,
              colour = "black",
              y_position = 750,
              tip_length = 0.05,
              textsize = 4) +
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("MICE", "HY")),
              annotations = p_label_MICE_HY,
              colour = "black",
              y_position = 1100,
              tip_length = 0.05,
```

#Overlap of shared genes with Botella 2025 (Supp Fig 3)
```{r}
botellaH3MICE <- read.xlsx("botella_data.xlsx", sheet = 2)
botellaH3SIE <- read.xlsx("botella_data.xlsx", sheet = 3)
botellaH24MICE <- read.xlsx("botella_data.xlsx", sheet = 4)
botellaH24SIE <- read.xlsx("botella_data.xlsx", sheet = 5)

allbotella <- read.xlsx("botella_data.xlsx", sheet = 1)
allbotella <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "external_gene_name"),
                     filters = "external_gene_name",
                     values = allbotella$Gene,
                     mart = mart)

allbotella <- allbotella$ensembl_gene_id
  
botellaMICEH3UP <- botellaH3MICE %>% dplyr::filter(log2FC > 0) %>% dplyr::filter(ENSEMBL %in% rownames(rna_compALLhypoxia)) %>% pull(ENSEMBL)
botellaSIEH3UP <- botellaH3SIE %>% dplyr::filter(log2FC > 0) %>% dplyr::filter(ENSEMBL %in% rownames(rna_compALLhypoxia)) %>% pull(ENSEMBL)

botellaMICEH24UP <- botellaH24MICE %>% dplyr::filter(log2FC > 0) %>% dplyr::filter(ENSEMBL %in% rownames(rna_compALLhypoxia)) %>% pull(ENSEMBL)
botellaSIEH24UP <- botellaH24SIE %>% dplyr::filter(log2FC > 0) %>% dplyr::filter(ENSEMBL %in% rownames(rna_compALLhypoxia)) %>% pull(ENSEMBL)

botellaMICEH3DOWN <- botellaH3MICE %>% dplyr::filter(log2FC < 0) %>% dplyr::filter(ENSEMBL %in% rownames(rna_compALLhypoxia)) %>% pull(ENSEMBL)
botellaSIEH3DOWN <- botellaH3SIE %>% dplyr::filter(log2FC < 0) %>% dplyr::filter(ENSEMBL %in% rownames(rna_compALLhypoxia)) %>% pull(ENSEMBL)

botellaMICEH24DOWN <- botellaH24MICE %>% dplyr::filter(log2FC < 0) %>% dplyr::filter(ENSEMBL %in% rownames(rna_compALLhypoxia)) %>% pull(ENSEMBL)
botellaSIEH24DOWN <- botellaH24SIE %>% dplyr::filter(log2FC < 0) %>% dplyr::filter(ENSEMBL %in% rownames(rna_compALLhypoxia)) %>% pull(ENSEMBL)

ourstudyH3UP <- intersect(SHAREDuniqueUPH3, allbotella)
ourstudyH3DOWN <- intersect(SHAREDuniqueDOWNH3, allbotella)
ourstudyH24UP <- intersect(SHAREDuniqueUPH24, allbotella)
ourstudyH24DOWN <- intersect(SHAREDuniqueDOWNH24, allbotella)
  
overlapdirection_geneshypoxia <- list(
  "ourstudyH3UP" = ourstudyH3UP,
  "ourstudyH3DOWN" = ourstudyH3DOWN,
  "ourstudyH24UP" = ourstudyH24UP,
  "ourstudyH24DOWN" = ourstudyH24DOWN,
  SIEH3DOWN = botellaSIEH3DOWN,
  SIEH24DOWN = botellaSIEH24DOWN,
  MICEH3DOWN = botellaMICEH3DOWN,
  MICEH24DOWN = botellaMICEH24DOWN,
  SIEH3UP = botellaSIEH3UP,
  SIEH24UP = botellaSIEH24UP,
  MICEH3UP = botellaMICEH3UP,
  MICEH24UP = botellaMICEH24UP
)

dfhypoxia <- stack(overlapdirection_geneshypoxia)

dfhypoxia <- stack(overlapdirection_geneshypoxia) %>%
  group_by(ind, values) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  complete(ind, values, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  spread(ind, n, fill = 0)

ordered_setshypoxia <- c("SIEH24DOWN","ourstudyH24DOWN","MICEH24DOWN","SIEH3DOWN","ourstudyH3DOWN","MICEH3DOWN","MICEH3UP","ourstudyH3UP","SIEH3UP","MICEH24UP","ourstudyH24UP","SIEH24UP")

ComplexUpset::upset(
  data = dfhypoxia[,-1],
  intersect = ordered_setshypoxia,
  labeller = ggplot2::as_labeller(c(
    "SIEH24DOWN" = "SIE (+24 h)","ourstudyH24DOWN" = "Shared between NA, HY, and NR (+24 h)", 
    "MICEH24DOWN" = "MICE (+24 h)","SIEH3DOWN" = "SIE (+3 h)","ourstudyH3DOWN" = "Shared between NA, HY, and NR (+3 h)",
    "MICEH3DOWN" = "MICE (+3 h)","MICEH3UP" = "MICE (+3 h)","ourstudyH3UP" = "Shared between NA, HY, and NR (+3 h)",
    "SIEH3UP" = "SIE (+3 h)","MICEH24UP" = "MICE (+24 h)","ourstudyH24UP" = "Shared between NA, HY, and NR (+24 h)",
    "SIEH24UP" = "SIE (+24 h)"
  )),
  base_annotations = list(
    'Overlapping genes' = intersection_size(
      counts = TRUE
    ) +
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  ),
  matrix = intersection_matrix(
    geom = geom_point(shape = 21, size = 1.5, stroke = 1.2),
    segment = geom_segment(linetype = 'blank', color = "white")
  ),
  queries = list(
    upset_query(set = "SIEH3DOWN", color = "black", fill = "lightgrey"),
    upset_query(set = "ourstudyH3DOWN", color = "black", fill = "lightgrey"),
    upset_query(set = "MICEH3DOWN", color = "black", fill = "lightgrey"),
    upset_query(set = "MICEH3UP", color = "black", fill = "lightgrey"),
    upset_query(set = "ourstudyH3UP", color = "black", fill = "lightgrey"),
    upset_query(set = "SIEH3UP", color = "black", fill = "lightgrey"),
    upset_query(set = "SIEH24DOWN", color = "black", fill = "darkgrey"),
    upset_query(set = "ourstudyH24DOWN", color = "black", fill = "darkgrey"),
    upset_query(set = "MICEH24DOWN", color = "black", fill = "darkgrey"),
    upset_query(set = "MICEH24UP", color = "black", fill = "darkgrey"),
    upset_query(set = "ourstudyH24UP", color = "black", fill = "darkgrey"),
    upset_query(set = "SIEH24UP", color = "black", fill = "darkgrey")
  ),
  sort_sets = FALSE,
  min_size = 1,
  set_sizes = upset_set_size() +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(..count.. == 0, "0", ..count..)), 
              hjust = 1.1, size = 2.5, stat = 'count') +
    ylab('No. DEGs') +
    ylim(c(10000, 0)),
  name = NULL,
  keep_empty_groups = TRUE,
  stripes = c("#ced8e3", "#ced8e3", "#ced8e3", "#ced8e3", "#ced8e3", "#ced8e3",
              "#e5cdd3","#e5cdd3","#e5cdd3","#e5cdd3","#e5cdd3","#e5cdd3"),
  themes = upset_modify_themes(
    list(
      'intersections_matrix' = theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=10)),
      'overall_sizes' = theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8)),
      'intersections' = theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
                              panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
                              plot.margin = margin(t = 0, b = 0))
    )
  )
)

allprevious <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "gene_biotype"),
                     filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
                     values = dfhypoxia$values,
                     mart = mart)

df1 <- merge(dfhypoxia, allprevious[, c("ensembl_gene_id", "gene_biotype")],
             by.x = "values", by.y = "ensembl_gene_id", all.x = TRUE)

df1 <- df1 %>%
  mutate(gene_biotype = case_when(
    gene_biotype == "lncRNA" ~ "ncRNA or unassigned",
    gene_biotype == "Mt_rRNA" ~ "ncRNA or unassigned",
    gene_biotype == "Mt_tRNA" ~ "ncRNA or unassigned",
    gene_biotype == "TR_C_gene" ~ "Protein coding",
    gene_biotype == "TR_V_gene" ~ "Protein coding",
    gene_biotype == "IG_C_gene" ~ "Protein coding",
    gene_biotype == "IG_V_pseudogene" ~ "ncRNA or unassigned",
    gene_biotype == "scaRNA" ~ "ncRNA or unassigned",
    gene_biotype == "snoRNA" ~ "ncRNA or unassigned",
    gene_biotype == "misc_RNA" ~ "ncRNA or unassigned",
    gene_biotype == "miRNA" ~ "ncRNA or unassigned",
    gene_biotype == "snRNA" ~ "ncRNA or unassigned",
    gene_biotype == "protein_coding" ~ "Protein coding",
    gene_biotype == "unitary_pseudogene" ~ "ncRNA or unassigned",
    gene_biotype == "unprocessed_pseudogene" ~ "ncRNA or unassigned",
    gene_biotype == "transcribed_unitary_pseudogene" ~ "ncRNA or unassigned",
    gene_biotype == "processed_pseudogene" ~ "ncRNA or unassigned",
    gene_biotype == "transcribed_processed_pseudogene" ~ "ncRNA or unassigned",
    gene_biotype == "transcribed_unprocessed_pseudogene" ~ "ncRNA or unassigned",
    gene_biotype == "ribozyme" ~ "ncRNA or unassigned",
    gene_biotype == "TEC" ~ "ncRNA or unassigned",
    gene_biotype == "artifact" ~ "ncRNA or unassigned",
    TRUE ~ gene_biotype
  )) %>%
  mutate(gene_biotype = ifelse(gene_biotype == "", "ncRNA or unassigned", gene_biotype))

df1 <- df1 %>%
  mutate(gene_biotype = ifelse(is.na(gene_biotype), "ncRNA or unassigned", gene_biotype))

df1 <- df1 %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), as.character)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(combo = paste0(c_across(-c(values, gene_biotype)), collapse = "")) %>%
  ungroup()

combo_total_counts <- df1 %>%
  group_by(combo, gene_biotype) %>%
  summarize(total_count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

valid_combos <- combo_total_counts %>%
  group_by(combo) %>%
  summarise(Totalcombo = sum(total_count)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Totalcombo > 0) %>%
  pull(combo)

combo_counts <- df1 %>%
  dplyr::filter(combo %in% valid_combos) %>%
  group_by(combo, gene_biotype) %>%
  summarize(n = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

combo_total_counts <- combo_counts %>%
  group_by(combo) %>%
  summarize(total_n = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_n))

combo_counts <- combo_counts %>%
  mutate(combo = factor(combo, levels = combo_total_counts$combo))

genotypecolour <- c(
  "ncRNA or unassigned" = "#2E7D32",
  "Protein coding"      = "#F57C00"
)

combo_counts$gene_biotype <- factor(combo_counts$gene_biotype,
                                       levels = c("Protein coding", "ncRNA or unassigned"))

countssumabs <- combo_counts %>%
  group_by(combo) %>%
  summarise(SumAbsGenes = sum(n), .groups = "drop")

combo_positions <- data.frame(combo = unique(combo_counts$combo))

ggplot(combo_counts, aes(x = combo, y = n, fill = gene_biotype)) +
  geom_segment(data = combo_positions,
               aes(x = combo, xend = combo, y = 0, yend = 1775),
               inherit.aes = FALSE,
               color = "grey90", size = 0.3, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(atop("Sets of DEGs", "relative to PRE")),
       fill = str_wrap("Gene biotype", width = 25)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0)), 
                     limits = c(0, 1300), 
                     breaks = seq(200, 1200, by = 200)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = genotypecolour) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
        legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
        axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(pattern = "none")),
         pattern = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE, override.aes = list(fill = "white", colour="black"))) + 
  geom_text(data = countssumabs, aes(x = combo, y = SumAbsGenes, label = abs(SumAbsGenes)),
            inherit.aes=FALSE,
            vjust = -0.2, hjust = -0.1, angle = 55,
            size = 2.75, colour = "black")
```

```{r}
hypoxia_exercise_enrich <- function(specificgenestime_point, allgenestime_point, time_point, group, direction) {

  if(length(specificgenestime_point) < 10) {
  
    return(data.frame(Time = time_point, Direction = direction, Group = group, Description = 	"protein folding",
                      ID = NA, GeneRatio = NA, BgRatio = NA, pvalue = NA, p.adjust = NA, qvalue = NA,zScore = NA, FoldEnrichment = NA, RichFactor = NA,
                      geneID = NA, Count = NA))
  }
  
  setenrichment <- enrichGO(specificgenestime_point, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db",
                            universe = unique(rownames(allgenestime_point)), keyType = "ENSEMBL",
                            ont = "BP", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                            pAdjustMethod = "BH", readable = FALSE, pool = FALSE)
  
  #Check if setenrichment is NULL
  if (is.null(setenrichment)) {
    return(data.frame(Time = time_point, Direction = direction, Group = group, Description = "No enrichment",
                      ID = NA, GeneRatio = NA, BgRatio = NA, pvalue = NA, p.adjust = NA, qvalue = NA, zScore = NA, FoldEnrichment = NA, RichFactor = NA,
                      geneID = NA, Count = NA))
  }
  
  setenrichment  <- as.data.frame(setenrichment@result) %>%
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    mutate(Time = time_point, Direction = direction, Group = group)
  
  return(setenrichment)
}
```

```{r}
meta <- sampledatahypoxia

data(dorothea_hs, package = "dorothea")

#filter confidence

expr_data$ensembl <- rownames(expr_data)

symbol <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "external_gene_name"),
                     filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
                     values = expr_data$ensembl,
                     mart = mart)

expr_data <- merge(expr_data, symbol,
             by.x = "ensembl", by.y = "ensembl_gene_id", all.x = TRUE)

expr_data <- expr_data[!duplicated(expr_data$external_gene_name) & !is.na(expr_data$external_gene_name), ]
rownames(expr_data) <- expr_data$external_gene_name
expr_data <- expr_data %>% dplyr::select(c(2:121))

tf_activity_wide <- dorothea::run_viper(expr_data, dorothea_data, tidy = FALSE)

tf_long <- as.data.frame(tf_activity_wide) %>%
  rownames_to_column("TF") %>%
  pivot_longer(-TF, names_to = "rnaseq", values_to = "activity") %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "rnaseq")

tf_long$time <- factor(tf_long$time, levels = c("PRE", "POST", "H3", "H24"))

tf_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(TF == "ESRRA") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = activity, color = condition)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = sampleid)) +
  ggtitle("HIF1A TF Activity across Conditions and Timepoints") +
  facet_nested(. ~ condition)
  
meta$timecondition <- factor(paste(meta$time, meta$condition, sep="."))

designtf <- model.matrix(~ 0 + timecondition, data = meta)
colnames(designtf) <- gsub("timecondition", "", colnames(designtf))
rownames(designtf) <- colnames(expr_data)

contr.matrixhypoxiatf <- makeContrasts(
 "POSTvsPRE(NA)" = POST.NS-PRE.NS,
 "H3vsPRE(NA)" = H3.NS-PRE.NS,
 "H24vsPRE(NA)" = H24.NS-PRE.NS,
 "POSTvsPRE(NR)" = POST.NR-PRE.NR,
 "H3vsPRE(NR)" = H3.NR-PRE.NR,
 "H24vsPRE(NR)" = H24.NR-PRE.NR,
 "POSTvsPRE(HY)" = POST.HY-PRE.HY,
 "H3vsPRE(HY)" = H3.HY-PRE.HY,
 "H24vsPRE(HY)" = H24.HY-PRE.HY,
 "Dif at 24(HYvsNR)" = (H24.HY-PRE.HY) - (H24.NR-PRE.NR),
 "Dif at 3(HYvsNR)" = (H3.HY-PRE.HY) - (H3.NR-PRE.NR),
 "Dif at 3(NRvsNA)" = (H3.NR-PRE.NR) - (H3.NS-PRE.NS),
 "Dif at 24(NRvsNA)" = (H24.NR-PRE.NR) - (H24.NS-PRE.NS),
  levels = colnames(designtf))
contr.matrixhypoxiatf

corhypoxiatf <- duplicateCorrelation(tf_activity_wide, designtf, block=sampleidhypoxia)

fithypoxiatf <- lmFit(tf_activity_wide, design=designtf, 
  block=sampleidhypoxia, correlation=corhypoxiatf$consensus.correlation)

fithypoxiatf <- contrasts.fit(fithypoxiatf, contrasts=contr.matrixhypoxiatf)

fit2 <- eBayes(fithypoxiatf)

summary(decideTests(fit2, adjust.method = "BH", adj.P.Val=0.05))

rna_comphypoxiaALLTF <- topTable(fit2, n=Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
rna_comphypoxia <- subset(rna_comphypoxia, rna_comphypoxia$adj.P.Val<0.05)
```

```{r}
    result <- topTreat(efit, coef = coef, n = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
    result <- subset(result, result$adj.P.Val < 0.05)
    return(result)
  }
```

```{r}
uniqueHYup24TF <- setdiff(rownames(H24vsPREHY_upTF), c(rownames(H24vsPRENA_upTF), rownames(H24vsPRENR_upTF)))

H24vsPREHY_upTF$genes <- rownames(H24vsPREHY_upTF)
```
