#extract unique TFs for cytoscape
write.xlsx(as.data.frame(H24vsPREHY_upTFcheck), "onlyupinHYPOXIA.xlsx")

singlegenehypoxiatf <- function(gene) {
  
    genedata <- as.data.frame(tf_activity_wide)
    genedata <- tf_activity_wide[rownames(tf_activity_wide) == gene, , drop = FALSE]

    expression_df <- as.data.frame(t(genedata))
    colnames(expression_df) <- "log2FC"

    expression_df <- expression_df %>%
      rownames_to_column("colname") %>%
      mutate(colname = as.character(colname)) %>%
      extract(
              colname, 
              into = c("Condition", "Participant_code", "Time_point"),
              regex = "^(\\D{2})(\\d{1,2})(B|P\\d+)_.*$")

    expression_df <- expression_df %>%
      group_by(Condition, Participant_code) %>%

      mutate(log2FC_B = log2FC[Time_point == "B"]) %>%
      
      mutate(log2FC = log2FC - log2FC_B) %>%
      
      dplyr::select(-log2FC_B) %>%
      dplyr::filter(Time_point != "B") %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(gene = gene)
    
    expression_df <- merge(
        expression_df,
        sampledatahypoxia[, c("ID", "vo2")],
              by.x = "Participant_code", by.y = "ID",
              all.x = FALSE
          )

      expression_df <- expression_df %>%
      distinct()

      expression_df <- expression_df %>%
        group_by(Time_point, Condition, gene) %>%
        summarize(
              mean_log2FC = mean(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd_log2FC = sd(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop"
         )
      
   expression_df <- expression_df %>%
    mutate(
      Regulation = case_when(
        Condition == "HY" & Time_point == "P0" & gene %in% rownames(POSTvsPREHYTF) ~ ifelse(POSTvsPREHYTF[gene, "logFC"] > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
        Condition == "HY" & Time_point == "P3" & gene %in% rownames(H3vsPREHYTF) ~ ifelse(H3vsPREHYTF[gene, "logFC"] > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
        Condition == "HY" & Time_point == "P24" & gene %in% rownames(H24vsPREHYTF) ~ ifelse(H24vsPREHYTF[gene, "logFC"] > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
  
        Condition == "NA" & Time_point == "P0" & gene %in% rownames(POSTvsPRENATF) ~ ifelse(POSTvsPRENATF[gene, "logFC"] > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
        Condition == "NA" & Time_point == "P3" & gene %in% rownames(H3vsPRENATF) ~ ifelse(H3vsPRENATF[gene, "logFC"] > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
        Condition == "NA" & Time_point == "P24" & gene %in% rownames(H24vsPRENATF) ~ ifelse(H24vsPRENATF[gene, "logFC"] > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
  
        Condition == "NR" & Time_point == "P0" & gene %in% rownames(POSTvsPRENRTF) ~ ifelse(POSTvsPRENRTF[gene, "logFC"] > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
        Condition == "NR" & Time_point == "P3" & gene %in% rownames(H3vsPRENRTF) ~ ifelse(H3vsPRENRTF[gene, "logFC"] > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
        Condition == "NR" & Time_point == "P24" & gene %in% rownames(H24vsPRENRTF) ~ ifelse(H24vsPRENRTF[gene, "logFC"] > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
        TRUE ~ "Not DE"
      ),
      
      adj.P.Val = case_when(
        Condition == "HY" & Time_point == "P0" & gene %in% rownames(POSTvsPREHYTF) ~ POSTvsPREHYTF[gene, "adj.P.Val"],
        Condition == "HY" & Time_point == "P3" & gene %in% rownames(H3vsPREHYTF) ~ H3vsPREHYTF[gene, "adj.P.Val"],
        Condition == "HY" & Time_point == "P24" & gene %in% rownames(H24vsPREHYTF) ~ H24vsPREHYTF[gene, "adj.P.Val"],
  
        Condition == "NA" & Time_point == "P0" & gene %in% rownames(POSTvsPRENATF) ~ POSTvsPRENATF[gene, "adj.P.Val"],
        Condition == "NA" & Time_point == "P3" & gene %in% rownames(H3vsPRENATF) ~ H3vsPRENATF[gene, "adj.P.Val"],
        Condition == "NA" & Time_point == "P24" & gene %in% rownames(H24vsPRENATF) ~ H24vsPRENATF[gene, "adj.P.Val"],
  
        Condition == "NR" & Time_point == "P0" & gene %in% rownames(POSTvsPRENRTF) ~ POSTvsPRENRTF[gene, "adj.P.Val"],
        Condition == "NR" & Time_point == "P3" & gene %in% rownames(H3vsPRENRTF) ~ H3vsPRENRTF[gene, "adj.P.Val"],
        Condition == "NR" & Time_point == "P24" & gene %in% rownames(H24vsPRENRTF) ~ H24vsPRENRTF[gene, "adj.P.Val"],
        TRUE ~ 1
      ),
      type = "TF expression"
    )
  
    return(expression_df)
}

plot_tf_gene <- function(tf_symbol, tftitle, gene_id, lim1, lim2, lim3, show_y_title = TRUE) {

  HIF1aplottf <- singlegenehypoxiatf(tf_symbol)
  HIF1aplot <- singlegenehypoxia(gene_id)
  HIFploting <- bind_rows(HIF1aplottf, HIF1aplot)

  HIFploting$Condition <- factor(HIFploting$Condition, levels = c("NA", "HY", "NR"))
  HIFploting$Time_point <- factor(HIFploting$Time_point, levels = c("P0", "P3", "P24"),
                                  labels = c("+0 h", "+3 h", "+24 h"))
  HIFploting$Regulation <- factor(HIFploting$Regulation,
                                  levels = c("Upregulated", "Not DE", "Downregulated"))

  condition_background <- strip_nested(
    text_x = elem_list_text(colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    background_x = elem_list_rect(
      fill = c("NA" = "#3498db", "HY" = "#fcd703", "NR" = "#7ffa86")
    )
  )

  ggplot(data = HIFploting) +

    geom_col(data = HIFploting %>% dplyr::filter(type == "TF expression"),
             mapping = aes(y = mean_log2FC, x = Time_point, fill = adj.P.Val),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
    
    scale_fill_gradientn(name = "Adjusted p-value",
                         colours = c("red", "blue"),
                         limits = c(0, 0.05),
                         breaks = seq(0.01, 0.05, by = 0.01),
                         na.value = "black") +

    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0), colour = "black", size = 1) +

    geom_errorbar(HIFploting %>% dplyr::filter(type == "gene expression"),
                  mapping = aes(x = Time_point,
                      colour = Condition,
                      ymin = mean_log2FC - sd_log2FC,
                      ymax = mean_log2FC + sd_log2FC), width = 0.25, size = 0.6,
                  position = position_dodge(.3), show.legend = FALSE) +

    new_scale_fill() +

    geom_point(HIFploting %>% dplyr::filter(type == "gene expression"),
               mapping = aes(y = mean_log2FC, x = Time_point, fill = adj.P.Val, colour = Condition),
               shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 2, show.legend = FALSE) +

    scale_fill_gradientn(name = "Adjusted p-value",
                         colours = c("red", "blue"),
                         limits = c(0, 0.05),
                         breaks = seq(0.01, 0.05, by = 0.01),
                         na.value = "black") +
    
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(
      "NA" = "#3498db",
      "HY" = "#fcd703",
      "NR" = "#7ffa86"
    ), name = "Condition") +

    labs(
        x = NULL,
        y = if (show_y_title) bquote(Log[2]*FC ~ "relative to PRE") else NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_text(vjust = 2, size = 11),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.ticks.y = element_line(size = 1),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 1),
      plot.background = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(size = 1)
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(lim1, lim2),
                       breaks = seq(-10, 10, by = lim3),
                       labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
    
    ggtitle(tftitle) +
    
    facet_nested(~ Condition, scales = "free_y",
                 switch = "y", space = "free_y",
                 strip = condition_background)
}

#Full LOO analysis (Supp Fig 2)
```{r}
full_results <- lapply(colnames(contr.matrixhypoxia), function(x){

    topTable(
        efithypoxia,
        coef = x,
        number = Inf,
        adjust.method = "BH",
        sort.by = "none"
    )

})

names(full_results) <- colnames(contr.matrixhypoxia)

subjects <- unique(sampledatahypoxia$sampleid)

LOO_DEG_counts <- list()
LOO_logFC_cor <- list()
LOO_Jaccard <- list()

for(i in seq_along(subjects)){

    cat("Removing subject:", subjects[i], "\n")

    keep <- sampledatahypoxia$sampleid != subjects[i]

    counts_LOO <- hypoxia_data[, keep]
    meta_LOO <- sampledatahypoxia[keep, ]

    group_LOO <- meta_LOO[,3]

    y_LOO <- DGEList(
        counts = counts_LOO,
        group = group_LOO
    )

    y_LOO$samples$condition <- factor(meta_LOO$condition)
    y_LOO$samples$sampleid <- factor(meta_LOO$sampleid)
    y_LOO$samples$session <- factor(meta_LOO$session)

    keep.exprs <- filterByExpr(
        y_LOO,
        group = group_LOO
    )

    y_LOO <- y_LOO[
        keep.exprs,
        ,
        keep.lib.sizes = FALSE
    ]

    y_LOO <- calcNormFactors(
        y_LOO,
        method = "TMM"
    )

    meta_LOO$group_condition <- factor(
        paste(
            meta_LOO[,3],
            meta_LOO$condition,
            sep=""
        )
    )

    design_LOO <- model.matrix(
        ~0 + group_condition + session,
        data = meta_LOO
    )

    colnames(design_LOO) <- gsub(
        "group_condition",
        "",
        colnames(design_LOO)
    )

    contr_LOO <- makeContrasts(

        "POSTvsPRE(NA)" = POSTNS-PRENS,
        "H3vsPRE(NA)" = H3NS-PRENS,
        "H24vsPRE(NA)" = H24NS-PRENS,

        "POSTvsPRE(NR)" = POSTNR-PRENR,
        "H3vsPRE(NR)" = H3NR-PRENR,
        "H24vsPRE(NR)" = H24NR-PRENR,

        "POSTvsPRE(HY)" = POSTHY-PREHY,
        "H3vsPRE(HY)" = H3HY-PREHY,
        "H24vsPRE(HY)" = H24HY-PREHY,

        "Dif at 24(HYvsNR)" =
            (H24HY-PREHY) -
            (H24NR-PRENR),

        "Dif at 3(HYvsNR)" =
            (H3HY-PREHY) -
            (H3NR-PRENR),

        "Dif at 3(NRvsNA)" =
            (H3NR-PRENR) -
            (H3NS-PRENS),

        "Dif at 24(NRvsNA)" =
            (H24NR-PRENR) -
            (H24NS-PRENS),

        "Baseline(HYvsNA)" =
            PREHY-PRENS,

        "Baseline(NRvsNA)" =
            PRENR-PRENS,

        "Baseline(HYvsNR)" =
            PREHY-PRENR,

        levels = colnames(design_LOO)
    )

    fit_LOO <- voomLmFit(
        y_LOO,
        design = design_LOO,
        block = meta_LOO$sampleid,
        keep.EList = TRUE
    )

    fit_LOO <- contrasts.fit(
        fit_LOO,
        contrasts = contr_LOO
    )

    fit_LOO <- eBayes(fit_LOO)

    DEG_counts <- numeric(ncol(contr_LOO))
    logFC_cor <- numeric(ncol(contr_LOO))
    Jaccard <- numeric(ncol(contr_LOO))

    names(DEG_counts) <- colnames(contr_LOO)
    names(logFC_cor) <- colnames(contr_LOO)
    names(Jaccard) <- colnames(contr_LOO)

    for(j in seq_along(colnames(contr_LOO))){

        contrast <- colnames(contr_LOO)[j]

        loo <- topTable(
            fit_LOO,
            coef = contrast,
            number = Inf,
            adjust.method = "BH",
            sort.by = "none"
        )

        full <- full_results[[contrast]]

        common <- intersect(
            rownames(full),
            rownames(loo)
        )

        DEG_counts[j] <-
            sum(loo$adj.P.Val < 0.05)

        logFC_cor[j] <-
            cor(
                full[common,"logFC"],
                loo[common,"logFC"],
                use = "complete.obs"
            )

        sig.full <-
            rownames(full)[full$adj.P.Val < 0.05]

        sig.loo <-
            rownames(loo)[loo$adj.P.Val < 0.05]

        Jaccard[j] <-
            length(intersect(sig.full, sig.loo)) /
            length(union(sig.full, sig.loo))

    }

    LOO_DEG_counts[[subjects[i]]] <- DEG_counts
    LOO_logFC_cor[[subjects[i]]] <- logFC_cor
    LOO_Jaccard[[subjects[i]]] <- Jaccard

}

LOO_DEG_counts <- as.data.frame(
    do.call(rbind, LOO_DEG_counts)
)

LOO_logFC_cor <- as.data.frame(
    do.call(rbind, LOO_logFC_cor)
)

LOO_Jaccard <- as.data.frame(
    do.call(rbind, LOO_Jaccard)
)

DEG_long <- LOO_DEG_counts %>%
  rownames_to_column("Removed_subject") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Removed_subject,
    names_to = "Contrast",
    values_to = "DEG_count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Time = case_when(
      grepl("^POST", Contrast) ~ "POST",
      grepl("^H3", Contrast) ~ "H3",
      grepl("^H24", Contrast) ~ "H24"
    ),
    Condition = gsub(".*\\((.*)\\)", "\\1", Contrast)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Condition %in% c("NR", "NA", "HY")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Time %in% c("POST", "H3", "H24"))

DEG_long$Time <- factor(
  DEG_long$Time,
  levels = c("POST", "H3", "H24"),
  labels = c("+0 h", "+3 h", "+24 h")
)

DEG_long$Condition <- factor(
  DEG_long$Condition,
  levels = c("NA", "HY", "NR")
)

condition_background <- strip_nested(
    text_x = elem_list_text(colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    background_x = elem_list_rect(
      fill = c(
        "NA" = "#3498db",
        "HY" = "#fcd703",
        "NR" = "#7ffa86"
      )
    )
)

colourhypoxiacondition <- c(
  "NA" = "black",
  "HY" = "#3CDFE0",
  "NR" = "black"
)

DEG_average <- DEG_long %>%
  group_by(Time, Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_DEGs = mean(DEG_count),
    SD_DEGs = sd(DEG_count),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(DEG_long, aes(x = Time, y = DEG_count, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_col(
    DEG_average,
    mapping = aes(
      x = Time,
      y = Mean_DEGs,
      fill = Condition,
      colour = Condition
    ),

  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    DEG_average,
    mapping = aes(
      x = Time,

    width = 0.7,

  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.25,
    size = 2,

  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "HY" = "#fcd703",
      "NA" = "#2980b9",
      "NR" = "#7ffa86"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "HY" = "Hypoxia",

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = colourhypoxiacondition,

      "NA" = expression("21% FiO"[2]),

      "NR" = expression("21% FiO"[2])
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(

  ) +
  facet_nested(

    strip = condition_background
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,

  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(

first_condition_summary <- DEG_session_order %>%
  dplyr::filter(first_condition %in% c("HY", "NS")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Time, Condition, first_condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = n(),
    Mean_DEGs = mean(DEG_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_DEGs = sd(DEG_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_DEGs = median(DEG_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min_DEGs = min(DEG_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_DEGs = max(DEG_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

first_condition_tests <- DEG_session_order %>%
  dplyr::filter(first_condition %in% c("HY", "NS")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Time, Condition) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~{
    x <- .x %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(DEG_count))

    if(length(unique(x$first_condition)) == 2) {
      fit <- lm(DEG_count ~ first_condition, data = x)
      a <- anova(fit)

      data.frame(
        Mean_HY_first = mean(
          x$DEG_count[x$first_condition == "HY"],
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        Mean_NS_first = mean(
          x$DEG_count[x$first_condition == "NS"],
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        Difference_HY_minus_NS =
          mean(
            x$DEG_count[x$first_condition == "HY"],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ) -
          mean(
            x$DEG_count[x$first_condition == "NS"],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
        F = a$`F value`[1],
        p_value = a$`Pr(>F)`[1]
      )
    } else {
      data.frame(
        Mean_HY_first = NA_real_,
        Mean_NS_first = NA_real_,
        Difference_HY_minus_NS = NA_real_,
        F = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_
      )
    }
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  )

second_condition_summary <- DEG_session_order %>%
  dplyr::filter(second_condition %in% c("HY", "NS")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Time, Condition, second_condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = n(),
    Mean_DEGs = mean(DEG_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_DEGs = sd(DEG_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_DEGs = median(DEG_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min_DEGs = min(DEG_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_DEGs = max(DEG_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

    } else {

        Difference_HY_minus_NS = NA_real_,

        p_value = NA_real_
      )
    }

extract_genes <- function(coef, efitn) {
      resultn <- topTreat(efitn, coef = coef, n = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
      return(resultn)
    }

process_sup_data1 <- function(Suppdatafile){

  SuppdatafileENSEMBL <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "external_gene_name"),
                           filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
                           values = Suppdatafile$GeneID,
                           mart = mart)
  
  Suppdatafile <- merge(Suppdatafile, SuppdatafileENSEMBL,
                     by.x = "GeneID", by.y = "ensembl_gene_id", all.x = TRUE)
  
  Suppdatafile <- Suppdatafile %>%
    distinct(.keep_all = TRUE)
  
  Suppdatafile <- Suppdatafile %>% 
    dplyr::select(GeneID, external_gene_name, logFC, P.Value, adj.P.Val, Condition, Time, Contrast)
  
  Suppdatafile$external_gene_name[is.na(Suppdatafile$external_gene_name)] <- ""
  
  colnames(Suppdatafile) <- c("Ensembl", "Symbol", "Log2FC", "P.Val", "Adj.P.Val", "Condition", "Time", "Contrast")
  
  Suppdatafile <- Suppdatafile %>%
    mutate(Significant = ifelse(Adj.P.Val < 0.05, "Yes", "No"))
  
  return(Suppdatafile)
}

Suppdata1 <- process_sup_data1(Suppdata)

Suppdata1 <- Suppdata1 %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Ensembl, Symbol, Time),
    names_from = Condition,
    values_from = c(Log2FC, P.Val, Adj.P.Val),
    names_sep = "_"
  )

Suppdata1 <- Suppdata1 %>%
  mutate(
    Shared_up = (Adj.P.Val_HY < 0.05 & Log2FC_HY > 0) &
                (Adj.P.Val_NR < 0.05 & Log2FC_NR > 0) &
                (Adj.P.Val_NA < 0.05 & Log2FC_NA > 0),
    
    Shared_down = (Adj.P.Val_HY < 0.05 & Log2FC_HY < 0) &
                  (Adj.P.Val_NR < 0.05 & Log2FC_NR < 0) &
                  (Adj.P.Val_NA < 0.05 & Log2FC_NA < 0),
    
    Hypoxia_specific_up = (Adj.P.Val_HY < 0.05 & Log2FC_HY > 0) &
                          (Adj.P.Val_NR >= 0.05 | Log2FC_NR <= 0) &
                          (Adj.P.Val_NA >= 0.05 | Log2FC_NA <= 0),
    
    Hypoxia_specific_down = (Adj.P.Val_HY < 0.05 & Log2FC_HY < 0) &
                            (Adj.P.Val_NR >= 0.05 | Log2FC_NR >= 0) &
                            (Adj.P.Val_NA >= 0.05 | Log2FC_NA >= 0),
    
    Intensity_specific_up = (Adj.P.Val_HY < 0.05 & Log2FC_HY > 0) &
                            (Adj.P.Val_NR < 0.05 & Log2FC_NR > 0) &
                            (Adj.P.Val_NA >= 0.05 | Log2FC_NA <= 0),
    
    Intensity_specific_down = (Adj.P.Val_HY < 0.05 & Log2FC_HY < 0) &
                              (Adj.P.Val_NR < 0.05 & Log2FC_NR < 0) &
                              (Adj.P.Val_NA >= 0.05 | Log2FC_NA >= 0)
  )

Suppdata1 <- Suppdata1 %>%
  mutate(
    Shared_up      = ifelse(Shared_up, "+", "-"),
    Hypoxia_specific_up     = ifelse(Hypoxia_specific_up, "+", "-"),
    Intensity_specific_up   = ifelse(Intensity_specific_up, "+", "-"),
    Shared_down      = ifelse(Shared_down, "+", "-"),
    Hypoxia_specific_down     = ifelse(Hypoxia_specific_down, "+", "-"),
    Intensity_specific_down   = ifelse(Intensity_specific_down, "+", "-")
  )

                 (adj.P.Val_NA >= 0.05 | logFC_NA <= 0),
    
    Hypoxia_specific_down = (adj.P.Val_HY < 0.05 & logFC_HY < 0) &
                   (adj.P.Val_NR >= 0.05 | logFC_NR >= 0) &
                   (adj.P.Val_NA >= 0.05 | logFC_NA >= 0),
    
    Intensity_specific_up = (adj.P.Val_NR < 0.05 & logFC_NR > 0) &
                   (adj.P.Val_HY >= 0.05 | logFC_HY <= 0) &
                   (adj.P.Val_NA >= 0.05 | logFC_NA <= 0),
    
    Intensity_specific_down = (adj.P.Val_NR < 0.05 & logFC_NR < 0) &
                     (adj.P.Val_HY >= 0.05 | logFC_HY >= 0) &
                     (adj.P.Val_NA >= 0.05 | logFC_NA >= 0)
  )

Suppdata8 <- Suppdata8 %>%
  mutate(
    Shared_up      = ifelse(Shared_up, "+", "-"),
    Hypoxia_specific_up     = ifelse(Hypoxia_specific_up, "+", "-"),
    Intensity_specific_up   = ifelse(Intensity_specific_up, "+", "-"),
    Shared_down      = ifelse(Shared_down, "+", "-"),
    Hypoxia_specific_down     = ifelse(Hypoxia_specific_down, "+", "-"),
    Intensity_specific_down   = ifelse(Intensity_specific_down, "+", "-")
  )

H3_genes_UP <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  ourstudyH3UP, botellaMICEH3UP, botellaSIEH3UP
))

H3_genes_DOWN <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  ourstudyH3DOWN, botellaMICEH3DOWN, botellaSIEH3DOWN
))

botellaH3MICE <- read.xlsx("botella_data.xlsx", sheet = 2) %>%
  dplyr::filter(ENSEMBL %in% c(H3_genes_UP, H3_genes_DOWN)) %>%
  mutate(Time = "+3 h") %>%
  dplyr::select(ENSEMBL, SYMBOL, Time, log2FC, P.Value, adj.P.Val)
colnames(botellaH3MICE) <- c("Ensembl", "Symbol", "Time", "Log2FC_MICE", "P.Val_MICE", "Adj.P.Val_MICE")

botellaH3SIE <- read.xlsx("botella_data.xlsx", sheet = 3) %>%
  dplyr::filter(ENSEMBL %in% c(H3_genes_UP, H3_genes_DOWN)) %>%
  mutate(Time = "+3 h") %>%
  dplyr::select(ENSEMBL, SYMBOL, Time, log2FC, P.Value, adj.P.Val)
colnames(botellaH3SIE) <- c("Ensembl", "Symbol", "Time", "Log2FC_SIE", "P.Val_SIE", "Adj.P.Val_SIE")

H24_genes_UP <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  ourstudyH24UP, botellaMICEH24UP, botellaSIEH24UP
))

H24_genes_DOWN <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  ourstudyH24DOWN, botellaMICEH24DOWN, botellaSIEH24DOWN
))

botellaH24MICE <- read.xlsx("botella_data.xlsx", sheet = 4) %>%
  dplyr::filter(ENSEMBL %in% c(H24_genes_UP, H24_genes_DOWN)) %>%
  mutate(Time = "+24 h") %>%
  dplyr::select(ENSEMBL, SYMBOL, Time, log2FC, P.Value, adj.P.Val)
colnames(botellaH24MICE) <- c("Ensembl", "Symbol", "Time", "Log2FC_MICE", "P.Val_MICE", "Adj.P.Val_MICE")

botellaH24SIE <- read.xlsx("botella_data.xlsx", sheet = 5) %>%
  dplyr::filter(ENSEMBL %in% c(H24_genes_UP, H24_genes_DOWN)) %>%
  mutate(Time = "+24 h") %>%
  dplyr::select(ENSEMBL, SYMBOL, Time, log2FC, P.Value, adj.P.Val)
colnames(botellaH24SIE) <- c("Ensembl", "Symbol", "Time", "Log2FC_SIE", "P.Val_SIE", "Adj.P.Val_SIE")

Suppdata9 <- Suppdata1[,1:12]
Suppdata9 <- Suppdata9 %>%
  dplyr::filter(Time != "+0 h")

H3_all <- full_join(botellaH3MICE, botellaH3SIE,
                    by = c("Ensembl", "Symbol", "Time"))
H24_all <- full_join(botellaH24MICE, botellaH24SIE,
                     by = c("Ensembl", "Symbol", "Time"))

botella_all <- bind_rows(H3_all, H24_all)

Suppdata9 <- Suppdata9 %>%
  left_join(botella_all, by = c("Ensembl", "Symbol", "Time"))

Suppdata9 <- Suppdata9 %>% na.omit()

Suppdata10 <- Suppdata10 %>% na.omit()

all_ids <- unique(unlist(str_split(Suppdata10$geneID, "/")))

mapping <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "external_gene_name"),
  filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
  values = all_ids,
  mart = mart
)

Suppdata10$Symbol <- sapply(Suppdata10$geneID, function(x) {
  ids <- str_split(x, "/")[[1]]
  mapped <- mapping$external_gene_name[match(ids, mapping$ensembl_gene_id)]
  paste(mapped, collapse = "/")
})

Suppdata10 <- Suppdata10 %>% 
    dplyr::select(ID, Description, GeneRatio, BgRatio, RichFactor, FoldEnrichment, zScore, pvalue, p.adjust, qvalue, geneID, Symbol, Count, Time, Direction, Group)

openxlsx::write.xlsx(list("Gene expression" = Suppdata1,
                          "Shared NA,HY,NR DEGs" = Suppdata2,
                          "Shared GOBP" = Suppdata3,
                          "Intensity-specific DEGs" = Suppdata4,
                          "Intensity-specific GOBP" = Suppdata5,
                          "Hypoxia-specific DEGs" = Suppdata6,
                          "Hypoxia-specific GOBP" = Suppdata7,
                          "TF activity" = Suppdata8,
                          "Shared NA,HY,NR,SIE,MICE DEGs" = Suppdata9,
                          "Shared NA,HY,NR,SIE,MICE GOBP" = Suppdata10),
                     file = "Supplementary_data_hypoxia.xlsx")
```
